comments: We stayed 5 nights at Laurelle's place and it was great.  Easy and flexible check in and out, plus access to her computer! The flat is central and quiet, a nice addition is hearing the clip clop of horse/carriages driving by.
listing_name: Midtown Pied-a-terre

comments: I had a truly enjoyable stay with Purva’s parents, excellent hosts, The apartment is very comfortable and located in a safe and convenient area. Just two-minuet walk through Columbia University campus take you to the subway. Purva responded straight away to my request and made it a breeze for me to get the keys from her parents. I would be happy to stay there again on my next visit to NYC! Pete
listing_name: Couldn't Be Closer To Columbia Uni

comments: Jenny was very kind  and helped us a lot. The Apartment is great very close to the subway and very private, everything was clean and nice (better than an hotel). I defenitely recommend Jenny's place if you want  to go to NYC.
listing_name: Bedroom in my apartment with a private bathroom.

comments:
I enjoyed my stay with Cynthia tremendously!! Her home is more beautiful than I ever imagined. It was a wonderful experience spending time with her and she is brillant at making her guests feel comfortable. She offers a warm haven to live that feels like home and her beautiful artwork is a festival for the eyes in every room. I did not want to leave. I felt like I was not just a guest, but part of her family. She goes the extra mile to welcoming her guests into her home. She spent a lot of time helping me get settled and giving me valuable information about places to eat and and have fun.
This was my first real visit to New York City and Cynthia was a most wise philosopher and guide to the city and to life. I couldn't believe how fortunate I was to have her as my host. She has so much positive passion and energy about her work and about people and she had a life changing effect on me. I am thrilled I got to meet her, and honored to call her a friend. People like Cynthia do not come around all the time, and when you get a rare opportunity to know them, PLEASE GRAB IT!!!!!!!
listing_name: UES Beautiful Blue Room

comments:
Clean apartment and clean room located near a subway station, a grocery store, a laundromat, ... Everything to make your stay comfortable and convenient. I never heard the neighbors and, while I was aware of the street's noise, it never prevented me from going to sleep. After all, as it was mentioned before, this is New York City.

Jane was a wonderful host. She was welcoming from the minute I arrived and she kept me aware of happenings in the city. She dealt with my odd hours and we shared many great conversations. I would definitely stay there again.
listing_name: Sun-Drenched Hamilton Hts Jewel

comments: We spent a fantastic 7 days here. A lovely, quirky, flat in a great location - close to excellent restraunts and coffee shops all recommended by Monica, with the subway station being only a couple of minutes walk away and the next stop Manhattan.
listing_name: Park Slope haven 15 mins from Soho

comments:
David & Rick's Place was just amazing - as David & Rick are themself. Very centraly located, the appartment is def.more than just a "room". You have a whole floor just for yourself, everything is clean and looks more than nice.

David & Rick are the best hosts you can imagine. As David was at home most of the time we where there (but upstairs, never ever bothering you!), he helped us with every question, gave us tips and told us where to go to.

If you're looking for a cool, centraly located, clean & even stylish place with more than just friendly hosts - contact them.

Raffael & Lukas
listing_name: Beautiful Meatpacking District Loft

comments: I stayed for 5 Nights. Agnes is a nice host and puts on a great breakfast. The room is small but clean and comfortable. the apartment is very close to the metro  (4min.) and you've the express train D as well!
listing_name: Traveling Nurses and Medical Professionals

comments: A beautiful lady, cat, and apartment in a wonderful neighborhood. The bed is the most comfortable I have ever slept on, and Victoria's place is super clean. She was vey friendly and helpful with directions around town. The private room was a big plus and I hope to return one day!
listing_name: Manhattan Room

comments: Our small film cast and crew (about 7 people) stayed here for over a week in December of 2011.  It was a perfect location for us to spread out and feel at home.  Transportation to other parts of Manhattan was very easy via subway and cab or car service.  Robin had a binder full of great recommendations for food and things to do in the neighborhood and we took advantage of the kitchen and the takeout options in the area.    Two of us were older people in their 80s and this was a great building for them to stay in because the elevator made it accessible. Spacious, comfortable, relaxing, lots of sunlight in the afternoon, many different beds and fold-out couch sleeping options.  Only tough part for a group this big was that the walls aren't floor to ceiling in all the rooms so you have to work out some quiet hours.  Overall, a great place to stay and we would do it again.
listing_name: SpaHa Loft: Enormous and Bright

comments: I am so grateful to Carol for opening her home to me so that I could be close to my daughter  who has a newborn!!!  It was delightful and exhausting being on baby duty during the day but it was so nice to be able to come to a quiet, clean and cozy place to refresh for the next day!!  If I had not had Carol's place, I would either had to either stay with my daughter in their tiny place or not be able to come at all.  So it meant so much to me to have Carol's place available.  I  will definitely hope to return to Carol's. She is a great host and a delightful person.  Thanks again Carol!!
listing_name: ALL ABOUT A VERY COMFORTABLE ROOM..

comments: The studio is very nice and well located, approximately 20 min. from Times Square.  We had a great stay at Charlies place. Edwin who showed us the studio and had to be up very late due to our late check-in was great and very helpful. I would definitely recommend this place to everyone who is looking for a great stay in NYC:)
listing_name: Beautiful Harlem Studio Apartment - private access

comments: Chris is a kind and upbeat host. The room is spacious and well-furnished and the entire apartment is clean and maintained. Great place to stay, hassle free arrangement. Highly recommended.
listing_name: Share in NYC's trendy East Village

comments: Very nice and spacious place in a very genuine and quiet area. Close to grocery stores and subway stations. Al is a wonderful and caring host, making sure you´ll get the very best out of your visit in NYC.
listing_name: Brooklyn Brownstone home share

comments: Sandra is a terrific host! Th apartment is as it appears in the photos. Perfect location and it has everything you can need. We spent there a week in August, and we enjoy a lot. The living room and the bedroom are very spacious, and we really feel like at home. The terrace is amazing. The general experience could not be better. I would strongly recommend Sara´s apartment.
listing_name: Luxury NYC 2 Bedroom with Terrace

comments:
We stayed there for 4 nights, 6 of us, and it was really good. I would say even very good for the money we paid. Very clean, everything arranged conveniently - plenty of linens, towels, basic food, toilettries etc. The street is nice and relatively quiet. Most important in this season - conditioning in both rooms. Backyard is nice, but hard to use because there are lots of tiny mosquitos.
The area outside the street itself looks not nice at all, but I guess, that's what it is. Subway is really very close, 4 minutes walk and it really takes 20 minutes to Manhattan.
The hosts are perfect.
listing_name: Apartment in Crown Heights, BKLYN

comments: The flat is really nice, my friends and I were very positively impressed - especially because it looks even better than the pictures, it is quiet & bright and has everything you need. Wayne's house is also in a very nice and safe neighbourhood and is located just a few blocks away from several subway lines, plus he is an extremely pleasant host. We definitely recommend staying there.
listing_name: City Room - Private Penthouse Apt.

comments: We had a fantastic stay at Akari's apartment. We couldn't really ask for a better location, particularly as we were first time visitors to New York. The apartment was clean, spacious and everything we needed was there. Wifi was available which is always handy and a great little backyard too. Akari was very welcoming and everything went smoothly, will definetly be recommending this place to anyone visiting New York from this side of the pond! (UK)
listing_name: Spacious, Furnished Unit with Private Backyard

comments:
Dani is a wonderful and gracious host. We actually weathered out Hurricane Sandy with her. We never lost power, the HBO on demand service kept us entertained during the storm, and Dani supplied us with homemade soup.

We love the NY Subway and the apt is located within a 5 min. walk from the station with the F and R trains that go to Manhattan making it a very convenient location for using public transportation. There is also the G train for a ride to trendy Williamsburg. Park Slope is a picturesque neighborhood and the apartment is located a half a block from 5th Avenue and a block and a half from 7th Avenue. Both streets are booming with stores, restaurants, banks, grocery stores, anything you could possibly need. Dani has a lot of info in the apt about restaurants, car services, maps that were most helpful to us to make our stay in Brooklyn wonderful.

There is a great reflexology office down the block on the corner of 12th St. and it was a great relief after walking city streets. Restaurants are plentiful, the Brooklyn Museum and Prospect Park a walk able distance, and a local car service is reliable and great value. When it comes to the apartment, the bed was extremely comfortable. Initially I thought I'd miss WIFI but doing searches and answering emails on the Mac computer was easier than using a tablet or smartphone. Dani's commitment to a Green home environment was appreciated.
listing_name: Park Slope Green Guest House

comments: Petra has a great apartment and was a good host. She stayed up till 2am when I finally arrived at her home and stayed up to have a quick chat and a cup of tea with me. She made an incredible omelette for me in the morning and the room was clean and comfy. Good area as well. Recommended:)
listing_name: Location Morena

comments:
French

C’est un peu comme être chez des amis!
César et Janina sont des hôtes super sympas ! Ils ont vraiment été accueillant, vous demande si vous n’avez besoin de rien et m’ont offert le petit dej’ durant les 4 jours que j’ai passé chez eux ! Ils seront également ravis de partager leur bon plan new yorkais et d’écouter vos récits de voyage, vos expériences autour d’un verre en rentrant le soir.

Leur appart est super, la chambre est grande, le lit tout neuf est super grand, avec serviette et couverture toute propre (correspond exactement à la photo). Les parties communes : la salle de bain est toujours bien rangée et propre, la douche est bien, le salon est grand et la cuisine est parfaite pour prendre le petit déjeuner avant d’explorer la big Apple !

Prenez le métro n°7 jusqu'à la station 52nd Streets (à 2min) et vous serez sur Manhattan en 15min.

N’optez surtout pas pour les hôtels du centre ville, les prix sont surévalués et souvent pour une chambre minuscule et avec toilettes et douche communes… Choisissez plutôt Airbnb, vivez avec des New Yorkais! et profitez de l’appartement de César.



English

Cesar and Janina are very friendly hosts. They made my stay at their place so enjoyable, the room is large and cosy, the bed brand new, the bed sheets fantastic (as you see it on the picture), the shared bathroom is great and extra clean with a good shower; the living room is large, it is perfect to have a nice talk with Cesar and Janina and the kitchen just what you need to take a good breakfast before exploring the city!

Do not go to Manhattan hotels, you will pay an incredible price for a tiny room with 10 people sharing one toilet and a bath! Use Airbnb instead and enjoy your stay at Cesar!
Thanks Janina and Cesar!
listing_name: Cozy New York  City private room

comments: Warm, comfortable, quite, and private home.  Host was absolutely, positively accommodating and friendly.  Perfect distance from the new Barclay Center in Brooklyn.
listing_name: Boutique Brooklyn Condo, Quiet St, Great Location

comments: Nitin was very lovely, and in contact even when in Guatemala. The apartment is in a fantastic location (we love the East Village, plenty to eat!) and very comfortable. Amazingly affordable also, it was a pleasure staying there. Highly recommended!
listing_name: Charming Loft in the East Village

comments: Nataliya's apartment is comfortable, clean and spacious home away-from-home. She was very generous and accommodating host. Highly recommended!
listing_name: Cozy Quiet Sunny 1br Ditmas Park Close to Train

comments: Gregorio has been helpful when I am planning my trip. He has given me enough time to look for alternative accommodation when the booking unfortunately cannot be executed. Thanks and regards, Anthony
listing_name: MANHATTAN Cozy, Neat, Nice, Bright ROOM

comments: This apartment has perfect location in west village, close to good restaurants like the spotted pig and shops. We brought our baby and it was very convenient that everything is just a short stroll away. The apartment is right by a busy street, so you will hear the city noises though, but I guess thats New York. Thanks!
listing_name: West Village Loft, 1st floor

comments: Quel emplacement ! Placé idéalement à Chelsea, ce petit duplex est entre deux métros (trois lignes) et à 5/10 minutes à pied de la High Line, du Chelsea Market, de Broadway et du quartier en plein développement de Meatpacking. Supermarché à proximité, caviste (pour trouver une bonne bouteille de vin), boutiques diverses, Starbuck pour ceux qui veulent y prendre leur petit-déjeuner pas loin... Idéal pour un couple ou avec deux enfants. Wifi nickel. 5e étage sans ascenseur, ce qui est courant pour New York et qui fait un bon échauffement avant de partir découvrir la ville. Appartement bien équipé avec terrasse dont on peut profiter dés les premiers rayons de soleil. Facile à trouver et tout a parfaitement bien fonctionné. Nous le conseillons vivement et nous y retournerons dés que possible tellement NYC est une ville magique ! Pierrick & Maud
listing_name: One bedroom Duplex Private Terrace West Village

comments: You could not stay in a more perfect location than Garys apartment. Two minutes from Bleecker,  two minutes from the subway, close to Hudson, surronded by cafes, bars and restaurants. The studioapartement is nicely furnished and clean and well provided with fresh towels and sheets. even great coffee! The windows faces 7th s o it might not be the best choice for people who are sensitive to noice. Important to bring good earplugs! Gary is extremely easy to communicate with and always answers quickly and in a friendly way. The handing over of the keys worked great with his friend Arnel who was there to meet us. West Village is a nice part of NYC and this is the place to be if you want to feel at home in that area.
listing_name: West Village Loft, 1st floor

comments: My mum really enjoyed her stay at the Box Hotel. Super convenient, spacious, and friendly staff!
listing_name: Loft Suite

comments: Fantastic! Do not even think twice! Emily and Lou are the perfect hosts. The bed is comfortable, the neighborhood very safe (even at 3 in the morning alone), and Emily and Lou will insist that you help yourself in their kitchen (full of healthy food, yumi!). They provide essential things you may need like a hair-dryer, towels, a map of the subway or an umbrella but also very interesting conversations! They are the best to tell you where to eat in NYC or what to visit, and so good at making smoothies! I'm happy I had the chance to stay with them and to find like a piece of home thanks to them.
listing_name: Clean and Cute Shared Room in Very Safe Area

comments: My family and I had a great week in NY staying in Antonio's apartment. Even with 6 people, Antonio provided air bed for us, so we do not have to worry about any bed issue. Everything in the apartment was as advertised, it was clean, comfortable. Plus close to metro station.Even though gas was out one day, which is not his fault, but he is willing to work the situation out . Will recommend him to people who visiting NY.
listing_name: Cozy Modern 2 Bedroom Apartment 20 min from City

comments: We had a nice stay. The location is great and there was plenty of room for three people. It's great to have your own entrance and bathroom. Also they were very flexible concerning our check in.
listing_name: Heart of Bushwick 2 rooms and private bath

comments: Great place in a perfect location to explore all the happening spots.  Ben and Sarina's place was beautiful clean and comfortable and they took great care of us in organizing our stay.  Kitty Kats are both super friendly and were fun to have around.  Would love to return for a future visit and would recommend to anyone looking for the brooklyn experience.
listing_name: Gigantic Private Brooklyn Loft!

comments: Staying at Richelle place was an unique experience. I loved her passion for life and the warm welcome she deserved to me. She let me discover some unique places in NY and I did enjoy sharing our experiences and getting to know her and her son who is a talented young artist. Her apartment is very cute and extremely clean. It is conveniently located at walking distance to all major NY attractions and very close to Central Park. Last but not least Richelle's home made biscuits and muffins ! I definitively recommend to choose her place and discovering Richelle exciting world.
listing_name: New York City for All Seasons!

comments: Aletia is kind and down to earth, and she takes good care of her place.  I stayed for 1 month in the summer and loved talking with her when I see her in the kitchen.  Her place is very convenient.  The 1 subway line and Duane Reade are just a few steps away.  During the day there are lots of families and kids in the neighborhood and it felt safe.  I would recommend staying with Aletia anytime!
listing_name: Manhattan Gorgeous Very Spacious Room.

comments: Maya has created a wonderful piece of the world in the historic Greenpoint Duplex. Some great vintage pieces and very comfortable. She was very flexible with check in and the map with suggestions for cafe's, bar's and shopping was extremely helpful for someone new to the area. Thanks Maya!
listing_name: Sweet Historic Greenpoint Duplex

comments: We loved staying with Gregory, he was super welcoming and very helpful with what was happening in the city and how to get around etc. Unfortunately we didnt get to hang out with Gregory as our list of things to do in NYC kept us busy so we didnt cross paths too often. We felt comfortable and safe staying at his place at all times. I was a little worried about the bathroom being at the other end of the apartment but it was never an issue. Because the apartment is on the top floor nobody walks past.
listing_name: Private Bedroom in Williamsburg

comments:
Our stay at the Park Slope Green Guest House was wonderful. The neighbourhood has a safe, community feel and was within walking distance to many amenities.

The guest house itself was clean and bright with a cosy, lived-in atmosphere. We really appreciated the small touches like a full directory of takeout menus, most with feedback from Dani and use of the kitchen pantry.

I would definitely not hesitate to book again if we're back in NYC! Thanks for making our stay memorable.
listing_name: Park Slope Green Guest House

comments: My short but sweet stay at Sandra's house was great, her and her husband were very warm and welcoming. I would definitely stay here again!
listing_name: Big room W/ private bathroom in Queens, NYC

comments: The ideal place to stay and discover New York. A great apartment, which actually turned out to be a house with 3 floors and lots of space available, even for 6 people. We pretty much enjoyed the living room and different terraces, especially the roof terrace. The welcome and "guided tour" in the apartment was perfect and we also got some handy tips concerning the surroundings. The subway station "Atlantic Avenue" was just around the corner and in a few minutes ride we found ourselves in the heart of Manhattan. Nothing else to add here -> a clear recommendation to everybody who's looking for a place to stay in NY.
listing_name: *Available 1 year* 5BR Multi-Terrace Sunny Apt!

comments:
My boyfriend and I spent 2 weeks in New York and stayed in David and Rick's apartment the entire time. We were incredibly happy with our choice! The location, right in the heart of the Meatpacking District, was perfect for us. We were a few minutes walk from some great places, such as Chelsea Markets, The High Line, and MANY great restaurants and bars.

The apartment itself was clean, spacious, stylish and fun - And the designated guest area, is an entire floor with bathroom, TV, couch, coffee table, sofa bed and piano! There was more than enough room! They also had everything we needed - Soaps, shampoo, laundry detergent, toilet paper, milk, towels etc etc!

Despite the fact that David and Rick were away the entire time we stayed in their place (bar one day), they went out of their way to be amazing hosts! They gave us a list of all the places we should see, bars we should go to, even the best supermarkets. They made us feel welcome to ask any questions we had, and gave us great advice on what the city has to offer. They even called us from their own holiday multiple times to make sure we were having a great time!

All in all, a FANTASTIC experience thanks to David and Rick (and their beautiful apartment)! I definitely recommend to anyone going to New York!! Looking forward to seeing you in Sydney very soon Dave!
listing_name: Beautiful Meatpacking District Loft

comments:
Savannah's apartment was perfect. Everything was better than you can imagine with the pics: new, cozy, artsy, comfortable and perfect for a couple.
It is close to the J, M and G lines, so going to Manhattan is really easy. There's also a big drugstore just by the apt, where you can buy any basic.
Savannah was helpful and easy going, a really nice host. We would definitely come back to her apt.
listing_name: Artsy & Cozy. 2 stops from Manhattan! W/D in unit.

comments: The stay at MarQuerites apartment was the best on our roadtrip! The apartment is on the ground floor of her house and is beautifully decorated, everything looks very new and has a nice touch to it. It was exactly as described and as you see in the pictures. My family and I had a great stay, the beds were very comfortable and the whole place is very clean. The street is quiet. Marquerite and her husband are very nice and relaxed people, we feld very welcome and at home - they gave us great advice about restaurants in the neighborhood - we highly recommend the Jerk Chicken from the Exquisite restaurant at the Church Ave subway station! The neigborhood is very nice, we did not feel unsecure at any time, there is a very relaxed vibe all around. If guests come by car it can be parked directly in front of the house. Busses leave right on Church Ave and take you to Church Ave subway station in 10 minutes. We loved it, highly recommended and we would stay here again!
listing_name: The Ganham House

comments: The stay at Gya's appartment was perfect. She was so kind and lovely. The house was tidy and clean. I would recommend it without doubt. Thanks Gya!
listing_name: Private Bedroom WITH Living room and working space

comments:
I highly, HIGHLY recommend Chris's space! Being somewhat of a germaphobe I was not disappointed. Chris was super friendly and welcoming without being overbearing - the perfect balance of a great host. The apartment was super clean, spacious and perfectly located on the edge of Fort Greene (an amazing BK neighbourhood). Thanks so much for your hospitality Chris!!
Yael & Melissa
listing_name: Comfortable, Sunny Room

comments: Ahmed is super nice, accommodating and has a lovely place. I would recommend his place to anyone!
listing_name: Awesome balcony apt W Parking! 1 Block to Subway!

comments: I loved staying in Corey's cool apartment. The location is perfect - loads of bars/restaurants in the area, close to the foot of Williamsburg bridge, so Brooklyn is easy to get to (took me about 20 mins by bike). Hip Soho is just across Houston, and West Village/the High Line are 30 mins walk. The flat itself is also great, and organising keys etc was a breeze. I'd definitely stay here again.
listing_name: Charming Artist's Flat, East Village

comments: We stayed at Robertas for a short and sweet 4 nights. The home is very clean and neat with more than enough room for a couple and up to 4 people. Roberta lives down the stairs but the space is extremely private and quiet at night. She has a fully stocked kitchen for those who want to eat in and left us some fruit and drinks for mornings on the go. Subway is a short 5 minute walk in a beautiful and authentic Bedstuy neighborhood lined with gorgeous Brownstones. Roberta was very easy to communicate with and available all hours of the day! We extended our stay and would have loved to stay here longer but she had other guests arriving. Roberta was kind enough to hold our luggage for the day. Thank you Roberta for being a great host and hope to see you again soon!
listing_name: Style in Stuyvesant Heights

comments: I stayed for 8 days at the appartment. The room was big and clean. The appartment is located in a nice area in Astoria with restaurants and bars only a few blocks away. Also within close distance to the Q and N train which is ideal for visiting Manhattan. I would stay here again.
listing_name: Master Bedroom Private Bath Avaliable, Astoria

comments: Killer place in a great, safe location with a lot of stuff to do all within walking distance. The house was constantly clean and the room was very comfortable. Almost too good to be true! Erin was lovely and would sometimes cook nice vegan meals (mostly kale) and hang out. I would come back.
listing_name: Sunny, Modern room in East Village w City Views

comments:
Returning to this lovely place is probably the most sincere form of endorsement and, fortunately for me, I booked early enough to be able to.

With so much going for it, it's hard to imagine the Park Slope Green Guest House ever being empty - although everything is so spotless that it looks like you're the first guest!
listing_name: Park Slope Green Guest House

comments:
This great little apartment in Brooklyn is full of character. Bertte opened up her home to us and made us feel welcome. We were encouraged to utilize her kitchen if we wanted. The bed and furnishings were comfortable and the noise level was reasonable considering the location.
The location is within walking distance to the subway and many restaurants, bars and vintage shops in the Williamsburg area.
listing_name: Studio in South Williamsburg

comments:
My stay with Gus and Holly was delightful, which was a great first experience with using Airbnb. As hosts, they were very attentive to anything you may need and had great suggestions for local food, coffee, and bars. Not to be missed: their mind blowing theories about Jon Snow if you are a fan of Game of Thrones!

Their apartment is cozy and homey which is exactly what you need when you are so far from your own home. It's a great place to hang out, cook, drink, and unwind. There's also plenty of incredible books and music references and Star Wars memorabilia. (Spoiler alert: there is a light saber in your room!) I stayed in the loft bedroom which was perfect because it has a desk and plenty of storage space.

Gus & Holly are located right in the heart of Williamsburg, which is the hippest part of Brooklyn. So many things to do, so little time! It was just blocks from the L train so getting to Manhattan was very easy. Also, I felt very safe walking home alone at night.

*Note: Must love cuddly friendly cats. Also, there is a three story walk-up so don't bring too much luggage like I did!

Amazing place to crash while visiting the city! I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone! ;)
listing_name: Work From Our Home w/ Loft

comments: The apartment was great and comfortable. I stayed there with a friend for 9 nights and we enjoyed it a lot. The apartment is very close to the subway (J). I would defiantly go back there on my next visit to NY.
listing_name: Brooklyn Cove 1 Br Apt w/ Garden In Bushwick!!

comments: Erica was a wonderful host, and made the booking process very easy. Her home was very bright and peaceful, a perfect sanctuary to come home to after a long day exploring New York! Would definitely recommend her place.
listing_name: St. James Place 1.5-2bdrm 1block to PRATT & Gtrain

comments: While we didn't get to meet Rad in person, his wonderful neighbor Jill met us and made sure we were all settled in with all the information we needed. She was very knowledgable about the area and was able to give us some wonderful tips on some great restaurants nearby. Rad's place was a really great place to stay for us. Communication was quick and seamless. He was very organized, giving us all the information we needed in a very timely manner. The TriBeCa area is lovely, and so are Rad and Jill. We would definitely stay there again!
listing_name: Tribeca Artist Loft 1000 sq/feet

comments: Joan's place is nice and cozy, in a lovely neighborhood and close to center of town via the subway and by bus. The best part of the experience is not the place but the hosts: Joan and Fred. Such a lovely couple! One warning though, don't go alone as you may not want to leave.
listing_name: Fully Updated Modern 1 Bedroom Apartment

comments: We have a great time at Chris and Charisse place, they're really friendly. The place was great clean, organize, new and close to the metro station.  We are happy to recommend this place for any one who wants to visit NY.
listing_name: Skylight BR in Gorgeous Private Rooftop Apt

comments: A great apartment for a large family.    My family visiting from afar enjoyed their stay thoroughly and felt right at home.   Thank you Balram, for a great stay.
listing_name: Midtown Manhattan Duplex

comments: Ir was such an amazing time at Vivian's place, it was super quiet, the house and barroom was always clean, Vivian's son is really happy and respectful as his mom, the room is just want I needed as just as the picture describes :). The location is fantastic, 5 minutes to the train station, 5 minutes to 2 malls, 5 minutes to the laundry, half an hour to manhattan. The heating is good as well. Vivian was a great host! I'll highly recommend this place.
listing_name: Nice Private Room Beauty in Queens

comments: This was my fifth time renting from Maya (if that's not a ringing endorsement, I don't know what is!), and my first time staying in the sweet historic duplex. It certainly was sweet, and I was more than happy with everything. Maya is a truly wonderful host. Everything is always very clean, comfortable and well-decorated/designed. Yet another amazing stay! I couldn't ask for anything more.
listing_name: Sweet Historic Greenpoint Duplex

comments: Coates was an amazing host.  From the very moment I booked, he was extremely responsive and polite.  I was out for a business trip and once my colleague and I arrived, we were more than impressed.  The place was immaculate and had lots of breathing room.  It was comfortable and we enjoyed coming back after long days of work.  When I come back to New York, if this condo is available, I will definitely be staying here.  Hopefully, I can get back on a personal trip since it's right in the theater district!
listing_name: Conv. 2 Bedroom Luxury Condo, Amazing Views

comments: Everything was good. Had a small mishap but Ryan was quick to get things cleared. Spot is nice and comfortable. Shower was clean. The neighborhood is lovely. I would recommend this and would stay there again.
listing_name: Luxe Astoria: Spacious Suite -near Subway & Park

comments: Fuimos cuatro personas y todo fue estupendo. Lo recomiendo al 100%.
listing_name: Large newly renovated studio

comments: Patricia, thank you very much! We had wonderful stay. Subway is really right around the corner, and it takes you directly to Times Square (15 -20 minutes), Wall street and other places. We had absolutely no problems to get to the apartment. Neighborhood was safe - across the street there is community center, on the other side you can find hospital. Patricia was very helpful, she left us brochure with all places we should visit, restaurants, shopping malls, etc.. When we had a problem with water, she came in few minutes and made it work. Before we came, she gave us options of how to get there. Bed and also futton bed were really comfortable - 4 of us had no problem with sleeping. I personally loved bathroom!! It was very clean, towels were provided. Kitchen had everything you need. I would definitely recommend this place for short term stay! Thanks again Patricia!
listing_name: Large newly renovated studio

comments: I had a nice hassle free stay at Angelo's. I think it is a good value for money. Trains are rather loud and annoyed me during the day but I slept well and spent most of the time outside the apartment. The host is very easy going and most likely to offer you an ice cream.
listing_name: Sunny Room, Only 1 Block to Subway!

comments: I stayed at Estudio 129 with my girlfriend and 2 friends and it was all of our first experience using airbnb.  We all absolutely loved the place.  It was very clean and Ron was there to greet us when we arrived.  We were somewhat nervous because of its location but never once felt unsafe in the area and were happy to find several nice restaurants within a few blocks of the apartment.  Because of our experience here we will all use airbnb in the future and would absolutely stay in Estudio 129 again.
listing_name: Estudio 129

comments: We had a wonderful stay at this beautiful Brooklyn brownstone. Accommodations were very comfortable, spacious (entire third floor) and very clean. The neighborhood is family-oriented, shaded with trees and within easy walking distance of nice restaurants, transportation (subway, bus, taxi), a large park and downtown Brooklyn. We would definitely recommend it.
listing_name: Spacious & Sunny Safe Haven

comments: That was our first Airbnb experience (we booked "Authentic NYC Living 2" but we stayed at "OZWELL'S Overnight Lux Experience 2") and it was a great one. We loved our stay at Rodney and Desmond's place, they were both nice and very helpful. They provided us everything we need and they gave us a lot of advices about Brooklyn and Manhattan. We couldn't have the apartment at our arrival but the next day due to an accident that the previous renters had, so Desmond booked a hotel for us and it was ok. The 2nd day, Rodney came and took us to the apartment. It was huge (its designed for 5-6 person i guess), we only used the half of it. The kitchen was well equipped, the bed was comfortable and the bathroom was very nice. The house is well situated in a quite neighborhood, subway is in 5min walks and we had access to Manhattan with the express line (about in 15min). The last day, Desmond took us to the airport at 6am in a heavily raining day ! We stayed here 2 weeks and we loved it! We would greatly come again ! Thank you Rodney and Desmond !
listing_name: Authentic NYC Living 2

comments: Victoria was a nice host, room was fine, but skippy the cat will drive you mad. We had to leave a day early because the cat was obsessed with our room and wanted us out.
listing_name: Manhattan Room

comments:
Monica was great - very friendly, met me in person when I arrived to go over the house and keys. She had a nice notebook full of area information - transit, food, cafes, maps etc.

The room is very simple - it's basically the living room/kitchen that has a futon set up. Nothing fancy, but it's clean and comfortable. No AC, but a big fan and windows, so it was fine in June. Wifi was strong, and there is a simple kitchen/fridge if you wanted to cook. It's on the 3rd floor, but there is an elevator or stairs.

The location is great. Directly across from Prospect Park, in Prospect Lefferts Gardens. A 3 minute walk to the Prospect Park Metro which gets you into Manhattan easily, or a few other parts of Brooklyn. A 10 minute walk to Crown Heights. A few cafes within a 5 minute walk, several places for food, and a good natural foods store on the corner. And having the park across the street is great - running, walking, or just getting away from concrete.
listing_name: Brooklyn Apt next to Prospect Park

comments:
It was a hot afternoon and we could not find a rooftop bar in Chelsea without a long line. We still had our luggage and just wanted to sit down. After some fun times in the subway (it's not terribly hard, but you do need to pay attention) we arrived at our destination. Charisse and Christoph's place is super close to the subway, a very easy walk. We got into the apartment with no hassle - almost as if we lived there! Upon entry there was a glorious rooftop waiting for us. It was awesome. Our own private rooftop with no line. Unfortunately we forgot the wine, but it was great nonetheless.

The room was perfectly set up - just enough room for the two of us. Very comfortable, bright, clean and just lovely. We felt very much at home and are really thankful to have found this place!

We went to dinner at Northeast Kingdom and got great tips for bars nearby. We ended up in the Lower East Side, cabbed it back to Williamsburg for another stop and later had an easy ride back to the apartment. All in all - a great place to stay if you are hanging out in Brooklyn/LES. But, it will be hard to lure in friends from Manhattan.

Thanks for an awesome stay!!!
listing_name: Skylight BR in Gorgeous Private Rooftop Apt

comments: Had a great stay in NY at Christina's place. The room was spacious and having a private bathroom was the best!!! The apartment is located in a very nice area  Christina was an accomodating host. Would definitely stay there again!!!  There was no TV in the room but I didn't care about that.
listing_name: Great room priv/bathrm Eastside location 70's ST

comments:
I stayed with Emily and Lou for three nights during my stay in NYC and I loved every second of it. Emily left my first day but Lou did a great job hosting me and he made me an awesome breakfast every morning. Lou had a lot of tips on what to do in NY. The apartment is nice and clean and I slept like a baby on the mattress.

From the apartment it is easy to fin your way to Manhattan or other places by subway. I spent one day in Astoria park, which is really close, and went swimming in the outdoor pool. The area feels safe even when walking alone at night and people are helpful if you get lost.

Im thankful that I got to stay with you guys and I hope I can come back another time!
listing_name: Clean and Cute Shared Room in Very Safe Area

comments: Waldemar was extremely considerate and responsive to all my questions.  He even introduced me to other people staying at the residence and made me feel like I was at home.  I would definitely stay with Waldemar again.
listing_name: Room with En Suite Bathroom & Deck

comments: This was our first AirBnB experience and it exceeded all our expectations. My partner Luke and I had the most fabulous week staying at Gary's apartment. It is in such a great location close to lots of bars and restaurants and a short stroll to the subway. The apartment itself is lovely, it is super stylish with a comfy bed, good shower and has everything you may need. It was also meticulously clean. Gary also provided some great advice for yummy places to eat and things to see and do. One day hopefully we come back to New York in which case we would definitely want to stay at Gary's again.
listing_name: West Village Loft, 1st floor

comments: I cannot praise Natasha enough.  She's so friendly and an amazing host.  She is always there to recommend sites to visit and we had pleasant chats throughout the week I stayed with her.  I highly recommend her! The house is very close to the subway and maybe 20-30 minutes on the train from most of NYC's most popular attractions.  There are also a lot of restaurants near the house as well as a few tourist spots you won't want to miss!
listing_name: Private room near transport and Prospect Park

comments:
Our host Anthony was welcoming, accommodating of the changes to our schedule and available for questions and information. He checked in with us every 2-3 days make sure that all was well and there were no needs that were going unmet.

The property was exactly as advertised. The amenities were spotless and the building was quiet. If you are looking for a new York "neighborhood" experience, this would be an excellent choice. The location is close to public transportation. We walked or took public transportation back to the property at all hours of the day and night and never felt uncomfortable.

The communal kitchen was a very helpful. More importantly, the refrigerator in the room allowed us to have snacks cold and crisp when we arrived back at the room. The flat screen TV was great, the bed linens were fresh and the towels were large and fluffy. The communal bathroom was always spotless. The shower was hot and the water pressure was always strong.

This is an excellent choice if you plan to spend much of your visit in Brooklyn. It is 20 minutes from the BAM center and Downtown Brooklyn.

We intend to stay here again and heartily recommend it to groups and single travelers as a place where you can feel secure, yet experience a very "New York" experience.
listing_name: Brooklyn- Crown Heights Garden Apt.

comments:
Monicas flat is a great place to explore New York City and especially Brooklyn. From the window one can see the Prospekt Park, one of the bigist parks in town. In the surrounding streets are plenty shops, restaurants and shopping possibilities. Monica offers small maps of different Brooklyn neighborhoods. She has made them herself and they are very usefull.
The flat is small, clean and has everything to offer one need for a stay: WLAN, a kitchenette, a fridge, a bed, a clean bathroom...
Monica is a very kind host. I enjoyed my stay. Thank you.
listing_name: Brooklyn Apt next to Prospect Park

comments: Without no doubt, Pam and Jullien are great hosts. My wife and I stayed at their place for four nights and we really felt at home. That was actually the first time we tried to use Airbnb and we couldn't have been more satisfied. We had our own private entrance so we're not bothered by other guests. The room was clean, tidy,  and looked the same as in the pictures although the furniture placement was adjusted a little bit. The apartment is also convenient as it is located VERY CLOSE to the Utica subway station. On another note, we think the small fridge and microwave that were provided are really useful for travellers. Pam and Jullien have been very thoughtful about that. At last, if we have a chance to visit NY again, we would like to stay at their place again and would stay longer.
listing_name: New 1BR + 1BA with Private Entrance

comments:
Noelva was a very welcoming, extremely helpful hostess. I very much enjoyed sitting with her and her husband and just talking sometimes in the evening. I would most definitely recommend staying at her place, and hopefully when and if I'm ever in the NYC area, I will stay there.
City Island is such a refreshing, friendly little town in the midst of such a big city. Restaurants are excellent.
Sue White
listing_name: Great 1BD Apt- water front City Island Bronx NY

comments:
L'accueil a été agréable et patient (nous sommes arrivé plus tard que l'heure prévu et Julian guettait notre arrivée).
Julian et Karen sont discrets, souriants et disponibles si besoin.
L'appartement, situé en sous sol, est agréable malgré la petite fenetre. La terrasse sur l'arrière permet d'aller fumer en toute tranquillité si on le souhaite.
Il s'agit donc selon nous d'un bon rapport qualité prix.
La station de métro est proche et mène à Manhattan Sud en environ 20mn. Les métros sont nombreux et fonctionnent 24h/24.
L'arrivée par l'aéroport JFK est pratique par Airtrain + métro.
listing_name: Brooklyn Cove 1 Br Apt w/ Garden In Bushwick!!

comments:
Our family of four had a wonderful long weekend staying in Maurice's lovely apartment! Maurice couldn't have been more welcoming and was definitely a key to making our time there such a pleasure. The apartment was clean, comfortable and as lovely as the pictures. The walk to the subway was about 10 mins as described, and we headed into Manhattan each day to do things in Central Park, see Blue Man Group, etc.

We ate at two wonderful local restaurants in Brooklyn recommended by Maurice, and there were more choices than we could have taken advantage of, within an easy walk or taxi ride.

Maurice's friends and neighbors were a pleasure to meet, even playing some pick up basketball with one of our sons when we asked if there was a neighborhood game anywhere!

We highly recommend this beautiful and welcoming home and host.
listing_name: Brooklyn Amazing 2bedrm Luxury Apt

comments:
Buona esperienza con l'host, sempre disponibile e velocissimo nelle risposte alle mie domande.
Ottima la location, in zona piena di ristoranti, servizi e negozi.
L' appartamento aveva tutto il necessario per essere autonomi.
Perfetta la flessibilità per check in/out.
Ingresso metro a 200 m da casa e Whole foods store a 500 m per cibo biologico.
Buona offerta in rapporto al prezzo.
listing_name: 2 Bedroom Gem - Prime LES Location

comments:
Staying at Todd place was great! he is really nice and since the first day he was aware of everything, so you feel like at home.
The place is really nice and comfortable. The room is like the pics, double bed with a wardrobe. There's natural light and it's not very noisy, so you can rest during the night. Even though is small, it's enough if you want to spend some days visiting the city. I was there for one week and I am really happy. The location is also great.
If I have to come back I would chose Todd place again for sure!
listing_name: Temporary Flatmate in Lenox Hill on the UES (Manh)

comments: Beautiful brownstone right next to everything in Brooklyn! Everything about our stay was perfect, including our host, Alan.  I recommend this apartment to anyone with walking difficulties--there are only two steps (which lead into the apartment, there are none inside), the shower has multiple holding bars, and there are tons of restaurants nearby (as well as Prospect Park!).  The apartment was fully equipped and very clean, you couldn't ask for a better location or host!
listing_name: Beautiful Grdn. Apt. in Park Slope

comments: Goran is the man!!! If you're looking for a dope Brooklyn, New York experience then check out his place. Dead center in the most vibrant part of Brooklyn. The apartment was very well kept. and he knows all the best spots to drink and eat. taco trucks and rooftop bars. i enjoyed my stay. just beware the front door can pop back open when it seems closed so lock the door!! also no microwave. so no leftovers from any restaurants you visit but Goran's a chef so have him cook something up. ill definitely be visiting again
listing_name: Bedford L Prime Location 2-BR w/ Patio!

comments:
Véronique was a fantastic host, thanks so much for having us at your place. The apartment is perfectly located in the heart of LES. The room is cozy and because of the loft bed there is plenty of space. Véronique cared a lot and the entire apt is clean and equipped with all you need. Last but not least not to forget the wonderful little cat which made our days.

Thanks Véronique, we will be coming back again.

Susan & Toby
listing_name: Cozy bedroom in Lower East Side

comments:
Jessica's great. She was flexible with check-in and check-out. Affable and even helped me with my luggage! The listing description was very accurate and this was one of the nicest places I've stayed. Full stop.

Neighborhood is lively, but not rowdy. Good vibes all around. Near two subway lines and two grocery stores as well as a 99-cent store. Recommended.
listing_name: Spacious, Sunny, private one bedroom

comments: My stay at Sofia's was a good experience. It was convenient to get around, the subway station is just down the street and there were many restaurants and grocery shops a block away.
listing_name: Studio for one person

comments: I'm very satisfied with the apartment and especially the host.the place was clean, the location is easy to find.
listing_name: Near Times Square and Hell's Kitchen

comments: This was the perfect spot for my brief stay in Brooklyn. The room was exactly as advertised, clean, stylish and comfortable. David was a very accommodating and helpful host- really couldn't have asked for more. Thank you very much indeed!
listing_name: Lovely pied-à-terre, in an historic building

comments:
Jessica met us at the apartment when she said she would and gave us a tour. She was sweet and helpful and gave us her number for texts, etc. should we need it.
The apartment was very spacious, comfortable and in a great location. Just behind the parking lot is Uma's (one of the best restaurants in Rockaways), deli, ice cream shop and library--so it was very convenient. The beach was just a block away. We're looking forward to staying at Jessica's place again!
listing_name: Spacious Modern 2BD Apartment

comments: Perfect location and very cozy place for our four nights here in NYC. The beach is so beautiful for early morning sunrise and late night moon beams. The hosts were really nice and got out to greet us late in the late when we checked in and see us off in the rain. Very authentic individuals. We had a GREAT time visiting NYC while staying at this perfect escape from the craziness of a big city.
listing_name: Great 1BD waterfront City Island NY

comments: I really enjoyed my stay with Milan in his lovely Lower East Side apartment. The location is perfect for a great selection of bars, restaurants, shops and just walking around my favourite part of NYC. The room was a good size, bright and very clean, as was the apartment as a whole. It was great to have a bathroom to myself, and to be able to use the kitchen area for breakfast. Milan was very welcoming and generous, and I enjoyed hanging out and chatting with him about music and life in general. Staying with Milan, you get the added bonus of a second host in the form of his doorman Charles who was friendly and eager to help my stay be as smooth as possible. A great airbnb experience, and I would definitely stay with Milan again.
listing_name: High-end doorman bldg in the LES

comments: Easy contact with Wayne. The place is exactly as shown. Very clean, very spacious (especially for NYC standards) As mentioned below, this is a very safe neighborhood and extremely close to the subway line. Although I did not have much interact with Wayne (mostly because I was out and about all day) he did make me feel right at home and helped out any way he could. I would highly recommend this place to anyone.
listing_name: City Room - Private Luxury Suite

comments:
Me and my girlfriend stay in Anton's apartments for 8 days. It was our first time using this service. And it was great experience! Anton's apartment is as amazing as it looks on the photos above. Also it was our first time being in NY and we thought it would be difficult to get to any place in NY. But it was a piece of cake! When we enter the room, we felt like we enter our own room. The apartment was clean and cozy. And the cat was soooooo cute and friendly.
Anton is a great host and can help you with good advice about NY. SO I strongly recommend everybody, if there is a chance, rent this room. It's awesome!!
listing_name: BEST DEAL IN CHELSEA 1 bdrm NYC

comments: We had a great time! The location is fine. Near the Subway en in about 20 minutes at Times Square. The appartement was oke. It was nice to meet Gladys and Bob. Thanks for the bagels!
listing_name: Astoria/LIC  Private Home located near train

comments:
Lynn's place is in the perfect location, safe, close and easy access to everything! The room and the bed are very comfortable.
Thank you Lynn (and Adam!) for hosting me during my stay in NY (also for your help), it was a lovely week.
listing_name: UN/NYU medical steps away! Midtown East w/CAT

comments: Yes, host was great, neighborhood fantastic.
listing_name: Charming and Artsy LES 1-Bedroom

comments: Melissa was wonderful!  She was helpful and easy to work with.  We are grateful to her for providing such a beautiful space to reside.  Highly recommend Missy's!
listing_name: Missy's Place

comments: For my first airnbnb experience, Cynthia & Mirlet have set pretty high standards! Although we didn't see much of them over our 3 day stay in New Yorks, we were made to feel very much at home in their lovely apartment, which is as clean and lovely as the photos imply. The neighbourhood is great, with food and bars nearby, as well as the Museum of Moving Image and the Kaufman Astoria Studios. They're also just a minute from an N & Q subway station, taking about 15 minutes into the heart of Manhattan. A perfect location for a trip to New York City.
listing_name: Cozy Vibe Shared Studio - near subway and shops

comments:
We chose a stay at Eric's for a neighbourhood experience and a quiet place to lay our heads after NYC activities over our week in town. We got both, and more. Eric has done a beautiful job with this place, it is so homely, light and airy and has all the conveniences as listed, and more. It is also really self-contained with good security.

We would recommend the apartment for anyone wanting to stay in a down to earth Brooklyn neighbourhood whilst enjoying all that NYC has to offer. A southern-inspired Sunday brunch at Peaches on Lewis Avenue, 10 minutes walk from the apartment is a definite recommend too!

Eric has gone above and beyond as a host throughout - from his local recommendations to helping us out with travel guidance and returning something we left behind. We are really thankful that we had a chance to stay here, it really made our NYC experience.
listing_name: Large private suite in our home in Brooklyn.

comments: The apartment was charming and in a great location! Xiren answered all our questions clearly and quickly, a pleasure to interact with. I would definitely recommend this to any friend visiting the city!
listing_name: Charming Artist's Flat, East Village

comments:
This is a great base from which to explore NYC - Bushwick is a separate area with a lovely character, restaurants and bars yet very close with 2 subway lines into the heart of the city.
The room is spacious and private, with its own entrance.
David and his partner are lovely hosts, providing local information, when requested and ensuring that you feel comfortable in their home.
Thank you David for making my stay so enjoyable. Anne xxx
listing_name: Nice Bedroom in Central Bushwick!

comments: Paulo and Seth were extremely hospitable and accomodating.  We were given excellent directions to and from the city.  The location was great for me.. Short walk to the train.  They gave us their cell numbers in case we got lost (which we did, once).  The room was comfy and cozy.  Cleanliness is always a concern of mine, but I was immediately put at ease.   The room, bathroom, and the whole apartment was well kept and clean!  Hope to be as lucky to stay with them again during my next trip to NYC.
listing_name: Private Room in Woodside, Queens: Good Deal!

comments:
Not near to the station.
15minuts walk from the nearest station.
But Host is very kind and friendly and very cute.we had good time in NY.
listing_name: Sunny, Modern room in East Village w City Views

comments: Patricia's apartment was perfect for our trip. Clean and well presented and the location is excellent. Patty could not have been more helpful on our trip and was always available by email and organised our taxi back to the airport at a really early hour!!!! Would highly recommend this apartment.
listing_name: Bright Cozy Chinatown Studio Apt.

comments:
Our stay in NY has been great and it's partly due to Gina's flat and welcome.
Gina is a very nice person, friendly and ready to give any information you'll need about your stay (such as transportation tips). She even took us to a little tour of her neighborhood in order to show us convenient places to shop food and so on. She's also quite flexible on the check in/out time.
The flat in itself is nice, perfect for a couple I think. The bathroom is large (although not pictured in the flat's profile). The kitchen is really ok but because of roaches (only a few), you have to change the trash every day.
The flat is otherwise well situated with one subway station at less than 5 minutes by foot and another at less than 10 minutes.
In conclusion, I would recommend this place to anyone willing to have a nice time in NY.
listing_name: Cozy Studio Close to Central Park

comments: My partner and I had a wonderful stay at Mark's apartment. He was gracious enough to make special check-in arrangements so that our late night arrival was very simple and convenient, and he checked in with us frequently during our stay to make certain we were happy with the apartment. The location was excellent for what we wanted (it was a visit to family that lives in that neighborhood). There are plenty of nice restaurants and shops nearby, and the river walkway is very close for nice strolls. The apartment is comfortable and offers just enough separation between the main living area and the sleeping loft to make it private and accommodating if you and your partner have slightly different sleep schedules or wish to do light entertaining. I would definitely feel comfortable recommending this rental!
listing_name: Spacious duplex 1 bdrm 1.5 Baths + terrace!

comments:
Dena's apartment is very well located in Harlem, close to subway, restaurants and big avenues. It is in an almost all-inclusive luxury building, you will need nothing else but food. Just complaining a little bit about guest room curtains and Dena's pets, hair cat is all over the house.
Everything else, perfect!
Very good relation between cost-benefits!
listing_name: Hague House

comments: Great deal! Apartments located in a very good neighborhood; a lot of stores and eateries nearby, and it is very convenient to get to the A/C metro line. Kitchen, bathroom, and room itself are just great. I definitely recommend to stay there.
listing_name: A/C/G Trains - Home Share w/ Young Professionals

comments: Enjoyed my stay at Ruth's home very much! The apartment was very clean and Ruth was a very welcoming host, even checking up on us after we had left. The bed was a little firm for my taste, making it a little hard to sleep but that depends on the guest. Ruth definitely wanted to help out with anything she could including lending me a hair dryer when I realized I had forgotten mine. Would recommend!
listing_name: Clean, quiet, safe 25Min Dwntn NYC

comments: Super Unterkunft mit grossem Zimmer und kleinem Badezimmer, das alles hat, was es braucht. Viel Stauraum, Hand-/Badetücher, Shampoo und Haarfön. Super eingerichtet.
listing_name: St James Pl Landmark Home 1 block to PRATT/Gtrain

comments:
Me and my girlfriend we had a wonderful stay at Janes and Sante´s place. We found everything as described and shown on the pictures. The location was perfect for us. We could go to Manhatten in 20-30min and had various options to choose from. Ferry, G-Train or L-Train. The bed was very comfortable and the furniture really cool. We found everything we needed for our almost 10 days stay.
Jane and Sante were wonderful hosts and had a lot of useful advices regarding locations, bars or restaurants.
We would definitely select and recomend Janes apartment for another stay in New York.
listing_name: spacious room

comments:
This was the most perfect place for me and my family. We arrived late night and the place was warm and ready for us. Fresh flowers, cold soda/water and vine, and fruit. We spend 7 nights here at Edmund's and several times we where in contact with Edmund, sometimes because we needed information about the neighborhood other times because Edmund was checking up if everything was OK or if we needed anything - that is good service!
We didn't find it a problem that the metro was 15 min. walk away, it was quit nice to come "home" to a calm neighborhood and relax in the cosy apartment.
If you want to go to NY and see/feel/live other places than Manhatten then 562 Lexington av. is the place to go, we will recommend it to every one :-)
listing_name: The center of NYC, Brooklyn!

comments: Evelyn's West Village apartment is very cozy and warm. Great location!
listing_name: Charming Parlor Apt by Bleecker, Old World Village

comments:
This is a wonderful, affordable, cozy apartment in a great neighborhood. My 21 year old daughter and I stayed here for 6 nights over Christmas week and had an excellent time. The key access was easy, the apartment was clean and had everything we needed, and the neighborhood was convenient to public transportation. The pictures are very accurate. I particularly appreciated the bathroom access off the main room, versus the bedroom, since I slept on the pull out and didn't want to disturb my late sleeping daughter in the morning.
I would stay here again.
listing_name: Upper East 1 BDRM Great Location!

comments:
It was one of my best AirBnb stay. The room is exactly as shown. Very clean, big bed, everything sorted. Locality is very nice. Just two blocks from the subway. Wilsinia and Favio are both very polite and give you full privacy and kitchen to use. overall this is one of the best listing if you want to stay in New york.
I would love to stay again!!!
listing_name: Quaint Room

comments: Exactly as promised: very clean, comfortable, convenient, quiet, charming and secure. Easy in, easy out. Great location - easy to Park, French bakery, excellent Ramen restaurant, Absolute Bagels, etc. $24/day parking a block up on 107th. Highly recommend.
listing_name: Best City Area Columbia U Upper West Side C Park

comments: The room was as described and everything was fine.
listing_name: Nice & bright room in Bushwick

comments: We had an amazing stay with Valmik. The studio was spacious and clean. Valmik was so kind to leave us a NYE care package. He also left us bathroom necessities as well. The check in and out process was fast and easy. He accommodated all of our needs. We will definitely be staying there again if we are back in NY. It was even better than staying in a hotel, as we did the first three days because we had so much more room!
listing_name: LARGE GREAT STUDIO HELLS KITCHEN

comments: My boyfriend & I stayed at Jennifer's for about a week.  Her place is really clean, which is always the most important part for me.  The location was awesome, there are a ton of great places to eat around.  I didn't get to meet Jennifer, but she kept in contact & checked on us a few times through texts.  She's very, very nice.  My favorite part of everything was her cat Tika, I just fell in love and felt at home.  She's soo sweet and cuddly.  Super cozy, great experience.
listing_name: Cosy Sunny 1brm in Prospect Heights

comments: I loved Natasha and Jack. They are the sweetest and most wonderful people! My room was very comfortable. The bed was amazing, I got a great night sleep every evening. I spent hours on the couch with Natasha watching Downton Abbey, she's the best! I was always welcomed home with a cup of tea and conversation. I plan to stay again very soon!
listing_name: Perfect 4-Beds Home Near Beach, Boardwalk, Shops

comments: Lane was great, met us there when we arrived and explained everything and showed us around.  The apartment was wonderful as was the building.  All in all, great experience and would stay there again! 5 stars!
listing_name: Williamsburg Luxury- 30 days +

comments: convenient location. just a few min away from subway station. It is very close to SOHO and union square, which I like a lot. Very nice and helpful host. The room is clean and good for one person. It'll be a bit small for 2 persons. I have enjoyed staying there. The only small problem with me is the hot water came out a bit slow.
listing_name: Private East Village Gay-Friendly Dbl Room

comments: Gary's apartment is beautiful - very functional yet stylish and unique.  I especially liked the plants by the kitchen windows.  Bright space perched above the heart of the WV.
listing_name: West Village Loft, 1st floor

comments: Cesar and his wife were great hosts and the room they provided was exactly as expected. The house is lovely and very very clean. Ridiculously close to the metro that goes directly to times square i highly recommend this choice.
listing_name: YOU ROOM IN NYC

comments:
Andrew is absolutely fantastic! He was very responsive and patient with all my concerns. His condo has ample square footage (with everything you possibly would need for your stay) and in the perfect location. Access by subway is within minutes of walking out- a perfect location with a "feel at home vibe"
Thank you Andrew for your cozy abode!
Cheers
listing_name: Modern 1br downtown Manhattan

comments: Very accommodating. Véronique was very sweet and super nice.  The area offers a lot of organic healthy restaurants and there is a whole foods walking distance.  I would stay there again.
listing_name: Cozy bedroom in Lower East Side

comments:
Een prettig, ruim appartement, goed ingericht en geheel conform de foto's. Uitermate geschikt voor een gezelschap van 4 tot 5 personen. Centraal gelegen, winkels, bars en restaurantjes in de buurt. Metro station Nevins op 15 minuten lopen, van daar met 2/3 of 4/5 binnen no time naar Manhattan.
Eigenaresse Charlotta is sympathiek en behulpzaam, heette ons welkom en nam afscheid. Op een enkele vraag reageerde ze direct en adequaat. Kortom, een absolute aanrader!
listing_name: BIG & SUNNY, 1 STOP FROM MANHATTAN

comments: 뉴욕이 다 그렇듯 여기도 다닥다닥 붙어있는 작은 아파트입니다 5층을 계단으로 올라가 보면 끝에 방입니다 캐리어를 들고 올라가니 힘들었고 지저분? 했습니다 사진에 보이는 것은 대부분 주인과 공용으로 쓰는 공간이며 개인 공간은 다락방과 같은 침대가 있는 곳 밖에 없습니다 주인이 아주 친절하지만 집주인에게 에어비앤비 하는걸 비밀로 부쳐야하며 주변 환경도 그닥 좋진 않습니다 최고는 타임스퀘어나 브로드웨이가 너무 가깝가는것인데 그 쪽을 목적으로 하는 분들이 아니라면 추천해드리지 않습니다
listing_name: Hell's Kitchen Funky 80s Hideaway!

comments:
I had a fantastic time in the apartment. its was just as described clean and felt like home is the best complement I can pay. The area is great has very good local amenities and is very close to Police station so you feel safe which is great in such a big city. I would stay hear time after time great communication between Eunice and friends and I felt they would be able to help if I needed it.
My friend stayed in a Hotel and were very jealous when the saw the apartment I would recommend to anyone.
listing_name: Charming 1-BR in Gramercy

comments: Rez is a very warm and welcoming person. I really enjoyed staying with her for a few days. When I showed up with a bit of a cold, she gave me tea and she also had some very helpful suggestions for finding an apartment in NYC. Her place is very spacious and is in a pretty great location. It's very easy to get to other parts of the city but there's also quite a bit to explore right there in Crown Heights. The room itself was warm and cozy. I would highly recommend staying with Rez if you are visiting the city.
listing_name: Affordable Room in Artsy Apartment

comments:
John, Stephanie and baby D. have been amazing during my stay in their lovely apartment. They have, besides great hosts, been a true support during my hectic day's in NY and my creative journey as a filmmaker. I am thankful to have met them and would recommend their artistic loft to anyone who wan't to visit NY.
I am sure we'll meet again :-).
listing_name: Private bedroom in beautiful loft apartment

comments:
We found fresh flowers and basic foods, such as coffee and filters, eggs and a delicious loaf of bread and butter in the fridge.

How thoughtful!
listing_name: Serene Park Slope Garden Apartment

comments: We rented this place for my mother to stay while visiting us in Brooklyn. It was clean, wonderfully appointed, and very quiet, but also conveniently located. Sarah and her husband communicated regularly and made my mother feel very welcome. We're so happy to have found this place for future visits.
listing_name: Cozy & Private Fort Green Cottage

comments: We absolutely loved Thomas' place! It was beautifully decorated and the atmosphere made us feel at home. The beds were easier to reach than we first thought and the flat is well equipped. Also, the neighborhood is lovely and inviting.
listing_name: Authentic Luxury Designed Loft

comments: Ajay and Nassime were wonderful hosts and Ajay was great in helping myself and my travel partner on navigating the trains to/from the airports as well as providing a list of great restaurants and activities to in the Brooklyn area. Their space was great to drop our things and head out into the city for the 4 days we visited and a couple blocks down en route to the subway was a delicious bakery we stopped at every morning for pastries and coffee. Their apartment is lovely and as a fellow Lit nerd - seeing the collection of books was inspiring. Overall we loved our experience and would definitely stay with Ajay and Nassime again!
listing_name: 2 Bedroom midcentury Brooklyn Brownstone apartment

comments:
We had a great time in Gordon's flat. Gordon is a friendly and unobstrusive host. The apartment is located five minutes from the Subway in a quiet street in Brooklyn. It was very nice to sleep away from the bustle of Manhattan. There is a small terrace for smokers. We thank Gordon for his warm welcome and trust.
Recommended.
listing_name: BEST Bushwick 1 Bedroom Suite-15 min to Manhattan

comments: We just returned from our first-time-ever, 5-night stay in New York and we're so lucky to have found Carmia & Joe's listing! Their place looked just like the photos -- beautiful! The house is conveniently located next to two subway stations, super clean, comfortable and comes with all of the amenities you need. Carmia responded immediately to all of my emails (I sent a lot) and they were very accommodating with my request for an early check-in. They had water, orange juice and a bottle of rum waiting for us upon our arrival. Our 25-year-old son stayed the media room and loved it! Upon arriving home in the evenings, he would sit in their lovely backyard writing into wee hours of the evening. Carmia and Joe are good people and perfect hosts -- they truly care about their guests. Thank you Carmia and Joe for making our first stay in truly NYC amazing!
listing_name: Mid-Century Modern Garden Paradise

comments: We had a great stay at Barry's place - clean, comfortable and in a great location to get into Manhattan. (5 minute walk to the nearest subway). We were briefly met by Barry who gave us an intro to the place and a few pointers on the area. The apartment is situated in a fantastic block - make sure you check out the roof! Bushwick is also a really good spot for an explore, can recommend nearby Roberta's pizza and 929bk for a great brunch.
listing_name: Bushwick, private bedroom private bathroom lux

comments: Christa and Zach were very nice and helpful. The house itself is great and the room is small but definitely enough for one person traveling. Lively neighborhood with lots and close to convenient subway stop. Only thing is it's not super convenient to take public transport to airports so taxi or über is the better option.
listing_name: Stylish + Clean Private Suite in our home - BKLYN!

comments: If you're looking one of the best little secret kept in NY: meet Kristen and Anthony. Such a beautiful, kind and friendly couple! They definitely always tried to make you feel at ease and share a lot of interesting infos about NY; and even about life in general. Their place is comfy, well located and give you the opportunity to discover the neighbourough (in Brooklyn) and to reach Manhattan quite quickly (busses, subway, cab, etc... are easy to get). We spent something like 12 days at their place and we had no problems at all (friendly neighbours - not a noisy place at all - quiet clean - furnitures and kitchen availables). Thank you so much Anthony & Kristen, hope we'll meet in Brussels soon! That'd be our turn to share a lot of good stuffs with you... Take care! Jason & Alexia
listing_name: Sunlit Room near Prospect Park!

comments: This was a great place in a great location. Really close to the train and a some good bars, restaurants (please got o Roberta's) and coffee. The place was extremely spacious for NY and Abby was always quick to respond to texts. I would definitely recommend this place.
listing_name: Sunny Bushwick Apartment / Morgan L

comments: notre première expérience a été décevante , l'immeuble est vétuste, l'emplacement est bruyant, la  chambre est placée côté rue donc nuisances sonores, pas de rideaux  aux fenêtres, literie de mauvaise qualité, la salle de bain vétuste , pas de ménage
listing_name: Spacious Riverside Room

comments: Wonderful. Excellent host. Place clean, confortable and very accessible. Andre was amazing tell about everything in NY. He know all about this fantastic city.
listing_name: NYC-Great Cost x Benefit-Huge Room-Next to Subway.

comments: We stayed in Danica's house for 12 days and it was wonderful, the house is as described, the metro and train are just 2 bloks away from the house, grocerys and everything you need, the neighborhood is very calm, we enjoyed our staying there and if we have to come again to new York we would definitely stay over again :))
listing_name: Modern Apartment in the Heart of Brooklyn

comments: Biren and his mom were great hosts! Place is very nice and they made me feel very welcome, even provided me with a metro card and an umbrella! I spent some time with his mom and she is such a nice lady, wish I had more time to hang out with Biren too. If i want to be in that area again I will sure book their place!
listing_name: Cozy 15 mins Manhattan& 10 Mins LGA

comments: Ivan and I stayed with Hector back in the beginning of May. We love staying here!! Hector is very friendly and makes sure that your stay is pleasant. When arriving if he isn't there his father will let you in who is very nice as well. The place isn't far from the subway station to the 7 Train. The photos look exactly like the room! Very clean place and very nice location. Never once felt unsafe. The kitchen is nice to have of you don't want to be paying a fortune on eating out. The bathroom is a little small, but very functional and never had any issues while staying there. We loved having privacy during our stay, and if that's what you want, this is a good place to get it!!
listing_name: The Coziest Cove in Queens | Home Away From Home!

comments: Our family had a wonderful week long stay in Yves' home. It's a fantastic, extremely well-equipped property and the location is absolutely unbeatable. Tony was very accommodating and helpful with both our arrival and departure. Highly recommended for families traveling to the area. The other reviews are spot-on.
listing_name: *Available 1 year* 5BR Multi-Terrace Sunny Apt!

comments: Waldemar was most relaxed and welcoming; he seemed very unfazed and understanding when travel problems meant later than anticipated arrivals.  Carried my luggage upstairs to this charming room which was cool and comfortable.  As it was so hot, I did not avail myself of the little outdoor space, but it was pleasant to have the door open to the balcony allowing sunlight in. Having an en suite bathroom was definitely a plus; a relaxing place to shower and tidy up at the end of each day.  Neighborhood is great - a terrific 24hr. supermarket and an excellent coffee shop right on the doorstep; I chatted with people in both - very friendly.
listing_name: Room with En Suite Bathroom & Deck

comments: The apartment was very clean with a fantastic layout and great location. Would highly recommend and will try to book again when trying to stay near east village.
listing_name: Charming 1BR near Union Square

comments: Ben was a fantastic host.  He greeted us at the door as we pulled up to his home which was a great first impression.  His home was lovely it was really nice having the kitchen right there and bedrooms were perfect.  It was awesome having air conditioning in the home.  I know that may sound like a little thing but a few people we met in Manhattan said they were using Airbnb and there places didn't have air conditioning and trust me in the summer that was a really pleasure to have.  Ben really made us feel at home.  I definitely recommend his home for anyone looking to explore New York.  It was so close to the subway and several great restaurants are walking distance from his place.   Ben was very helpful is giving us ideas on what do in Brooklyn and his home looked exactly as it was described.  He also had a french press and fresh ground coffee for us which was a nice surprise.  Next time we are in New York we would definitely stay at Ben's home.
listing_name: Child-friendly w/ Yard access and Street Parking

comments: This apartment was amazing! it was clean, spacious and filled with everything someone needs to fell comfortable. Loved the neighborhood and got an added bonus when I found a Gluten Free Bakery and had dinner at Romans. Alison even gave me pointers on where to shop and was super friendly. This will be my first pick overtime i head to Brooklyn.
listing_name: Chic private apartment in  Victorian Townhouse

comments: We really much enjoyed our stay at Olivier's place as it was a modern and tiny appartement with a good kitchen, 2 bathrooms (one only with a toilet) and a small but good room for us with a comfortable bed. The neighbourhood is what i expected to be typical brooklyn as it had a beautiful flair. Metro was easy to reach with a short walk. Manhattan was about 30 minutes with the metro which was no problem. I highly recommend the appartement and would choose it again for a stay in NYC!
listing_name: A/C/G Trains - Home Share w/ Young Professionals

comments: First time not staying in a hotel in NYC and only 3rd time in the city. The listing was accurate. The neighborhood was nice. The on the street parking was challenging! The room was clean close to a subway stop so once we got parked, we did not drive again until we left. The host was helpful and unobtrusive. My son's first trip to the city! Great base and great value!
listing_name: Room with En Suite Bathroom & Deck

comments:
Our hosts was very sweet and understanding. Unfortunately we had to move after 5 days (booked 9) due to sickness because of some hefty mold in the bathroom. Luckily this problem should have been taken care of more or less on the same day we departed. Hopefully not a problem anymore.
