The neighbourhood was diverse and approximately 20-30min away from downtown Manhattan. Subway very close.
The cleaning in the apartment when we arrived and in the days we were there couldh be somewhat better. For instance the tea towels and washcloth in the kitchen was the same all along.
listing_name: Riverside Suite

comments: Joan and Fred were great hosts.  Fred met us when we checked in and gave us a thorough tour of the apartment.  They both communicated well with us and we felt that if something was needed all we had to do was call or text (nothing was needed, they had provided well).  Things were set up well and even the continental supplies for breakfast were much welcomed and enjoyed.  There are several restaurants near, a small grocery, laundromat and the F train is very close.  The street was quite (and I have stayed in several 4 & 5 star hotels in Manhattan and Brooklyn on very high floors and still heard a lot of street noise.  We will stay here again.
listing_name: Fully Updated Modern 1 Bedroom Apartment

comments: The neighbourhood was very guest friendly with a supermarket and convenience store within walking distance.  The subway was around the corner providing us easy access to Upper Manhattan and Central Park.  I appreciated the proximity to LaGuardia and being away from NYC.
listing_name: Beautiful Fully Furnished 1 bed/bth

comments:
Jennifer es ena exelente anfitriona, siempre está dispuesta a ayudar.
Nos esperó afuera de su casa pasando la media noche el día que llegamos.
Nos dejo alimentos para el desayuno del día siguiente, yo diria que mas que un desayuno.
La limpieza del lugar es maravillosa y deja cosumibles de muy buena calidad.
El anuncio es real a lo que encuentra.
El Barrio esta un poco lejos de Manhattan pero estubimos mucho tiempo y el precio calidad creo que es bueno.
Realmente mejor no nos pudo atender.
listing_name: Cozy 2BD APT close to subway

comments: Velma was easy to communicate with and the location was great, in a cool neighborhood very accessible to just about everywhere. The big flat screen TV and AC were a nice touch as well, and I'd recommend staying there again
listing_name: extemely sunny pre-war flat

comments:
Nice and friendly couple which made our stay much better with the staple pantry that meant that we didn`t have to go shopping the first thing we did. They also gave us a nice verbal and written tutorial of what was in the area as well as went the extra mile and gave us an extra fan to use since it was nearing 95F outside and inside felt almost just as warm in the beginning.
The neighborhood was nice, considering it`s Brooklyn and us being from Sweden we didn`t really know what to expect but we found our routes to walk and our stores that we used (both the supermarket near uttica if coming from the metro and just needing some basics or left out the door and then take a right at the corner, that was most likely the best one) and everyone was nice that we talked to, never really felt unsafe or anything.
Would recomend staying here, the beds were decent and overall a nice place.
listing_name: Sunny 3BR Brooklyn · Spacious & Well-Located

comments:
Saint nous a fait un accueil très chaleureux et plein d'humour.
Fruits et chocolat étaient au rendez-vous.

Il est très disponible pour des suggestions d'activités ou de visites et m'a même inscrit à la session matinale de la piscine en plein air de Central Park !

Son appartement est à deux pas du coin nord-est de Central Park, dans un quartier où, malgré des difficultés sociales palpables, nous n'avons pas ressenti d'insécurité.
listing_name: Sunny Private Room at Central Park!

comments: Mike's house is amazing. Super comfortable, great beach vibes and all the amenities you need. Mike couldn't have made it easier for us to stay there.
listing_name: Rockaways BEST Summer House

comments: Beautiful place in an ideal location! This was the perfect spot for a family weekend away in New York. We loved being able to walk to great stores and restaurants, easy walk to the subway, and close to a fantastic playground in Prospect Park. The house was large, nicely decorated, and comfortable. Bertie was very responsive when we had questions. A great experience!
listing_name: HUGE Sunny Duplex Loft with Garden

comments: We had a wonderful stay at Israel's apartment. It was just as advertised, perfect location, quiet and clean. We would definitely stay here again if we find ourselves back in Brooklyn. Israel was very responsive as well.
listing_name: PRIME 1br in Williamsburg

comments: Excellent location, couldn't be better to go walking around all the Williamsburg and enjoy this amazing area! Lot's of restaurants, small local business and special shops to get lost. Moreover you are 20' away to the city by subway. The house is secure, very comfortable & clean. Perry and T are kindly and always have great suggestions for you. I really recommend to all!
listing_name: Private Room in Prime Williamsburg

comments:
I had a great stay at this apartment, I needed to be in New York for 11 days and this was perfect! I had a little difficulty in opening the lock box (as it was my first time opening one!) but a quick call to Marilena and I was sorted!
The place was clean and the bed was comfortable to sleep in, great quality linen! The only thing that could be problematic for light sleepers is the subway running at night, but I left the fan on overnight which kind of drowned out the noise.
I loved the fact that the subway was so close to walk to as I was attending a course in Manhatten so could just take the R train directly.
I would definitely stay here again if I need to be in New York again! Great hosts, I received a few messages throughout my stay to check if everything was ok.
listing_name: A gem garden nook on Broadway & 42ST in Queens, NY

comments: Gyas place is roomy as described. My family, two adults, two kids could easily fit in there. There was a minor problem with the lock, but Gya fixed it in a hurry. She was also helpful and available if we had any questions or doubts. The neighborhood is caribian/mixed and we didn't feel unsafe at any time, day or night. Pretty close to Subway A or 3. Plenty of restaurants and takeaways. Supermarkets etc.
listing_name: Private Bedroom WITH Living room and working space

comments: great welcome from jenni in a super pretty and pleasant apartment, everything are to spend a good time, the room is cute and roomy with a good sleeping. the rooftop is just magical! delighted to have met jenni and friends. I highly recommend this rental !!!
listing_name: 1 bedroom in The East Village

comments: Everything about this houseboat was wonderful. It had everything we needed for a night at the marina. I particularly loved that we were at the end of the dock, so it felt like we had some privacy. Additionally, we felt extremely safe here. Ingrid was really nice and extremely helpful. We even looked into booking the boat for the following weekend after checking out!
listing_name: Houseboat Floating Cabin  Rockaway Surf's Up!

comments:
Pros: Location was great, Bobby's recommendations on local restaurants were spot on! We were literally in the hub of night life and delicious dining options. We also loved that it was a ten minute walk from our bus station. He was kind enough to leave us two cold beers upon our arrival-- very thoughtful.
Cons: We spotted two little baby roaches in the kitchen along with two maggots on the kitchen table. The advertisement said that the bedroom has Apple TV, but when we tried it, it wasn't working.
Overall, our stay was fine.
listing_name: Cool centrally located LES apt.

comments:
For this to be our 1st Airbnb stay I was completely pleased! Everything was very easy and Blair's place was exactly as it looks in the photo minus the Xmas decor ;-).
Although, we missed our opportunity to meet in person, Blair was available every step of the way via text when needed. Her friend Remick was great also and gave us valuable pointers on the area.
If you need to stay in Brooklyn you can't go wrong with Blair's place. Will be my go to place when I return.
listing_name: Heart of Bed Stuy

comments: I had a lovely stay at Catherine's place! It was very comfortable, clean, and peaceful. It was a short walk and easily accessible to the metro. Highly recommended!
listing_name: 1 BD in Washington Heights

comments: Sarah was a warm, welcoming, and gracious host during our stay. The cottage was well furnished and maintained; and it had a sunlight that was just beautiful. The outdoor garden area outside of the cottage was perfect for brunch and getting work done in the morning. Restaurants are nearby and the neighborhood was charming. We ate at Putnam's both mornings. The only hiccup that we experienced was upon arrival when our key to gate wouldn't work. Fortunately, Sarah answered immediately and we got everything squared away. I would definitely stay here again!
listing_name: Cozy & Private Fort Green Cottage

comments: We've stayed at the place for six days and it was wonderful. The location is great. The neighborhood itself is quite and it's easy to get to other parts of Brooklyn and Manhattan. The house is very cosy and comfortable. We've stayed there with our two young daughters and they have enjoyed the place as well. Yuval was very helpful with tips and other stuff during our stay. Recommended.
listing_name: Williamsburg/Greenpoint sunny apartment with patio

comments: Had a perfect stay, all was as described and shown in the photos. Natasha's sister met me late to let me in which was kind of her.
listing_name: Private room near transport and Prospect Park

comments: This has been one of my best airbnb experiences in NYC. Chris is a fantastic host, interesting guy, accomodating, knows the city super well. From helping us with our bags, to sharing some cool stories Chris was definitely a fantastic host. The place is in a great location literally a block and a half from the metro you can get to manhattan in less than 20 min. With all the cool bars within a few blocks of the apartment and the great rooftop and backyard you might find it worthwhile to enjoy williamsburg from this spot! The room was clean and comfortable but keep in mind it is NYC so its not the quietest place to be. I found I slept fine but those of you more sensitive to noise might wanna pack some earplugs! Other then that (which again is pretty much unavoidable in new york), this place was fantastic! Thanks so much Chris!! I'd strongly reccomend this spot.
listing_name: Entire Williamsburg Music Lovers Palace―1 Blk to L

comments: Our stay was exceptional! This was my first time staying in Brooklyn and it was a breath of fresh air to be out of the traditional hustle and bustle of Manhattan. The apartment has truly a "home" feel. Tastefully decorated and the house itself has it's own story to tell from the antiquitous wood crown molding to the intricacy of design of the parquet floor. Mark epitomized the true heart of hospitality and was very thoughtful in providing tips and assistance during our stay. The neighborhood has an eclectic population, all who were very kind and say "hello" as you pass by. We always felt safe in our surroundings and enjoyed a more cultured view of NYC. My humble thanks to Mark- would definitely book again!
listing_name: Elegant Stuyvesant Heights Retreat

comments: Carlos is a friendly and very welcoming host; the room is exactly as in pictures and spotless clean. The location is great if you want to explore the city, as it's really close to the subway, with local and express trains at any time. Highly recommended!
listing_name: !!! Designer room in NYC!!! 12 min to Time Square

comments: Sam was a great host. She provided all the necessities that made my stay very comfortable. Her description was accurate and the neighborhood was very safe. It was the best home away home experience I've ever had!
listing_name: 1 bedroom garden apartment

comments: Tout s'est trés bien passé avec Israel. Le logement est idéalement situé à 2min du métro, après une journée dans Manhattan c'est appréciable de se retrouver vite au calme! Le logement était très propre à notre arrivée.
listing_name: PRIME 1br in Williamsburg

comments: Chris was a great host. Very accommodating about my check out time, and stocked the fridge with Pellegrino, OJ and bagels. If you are familiar with the Lower East Side, you know you are in a great part of the city and for a single person or couple looking to have a decent place to crash while engaging in the hustle and bustle of New York- look no further.
listing_name: Studio in the LES

comments: The house is absolutely gorgeous. The neighbourhood was fantastic. Very lively and friendly. The charming terrasse makes the whole place worth it.
listing_name: Maison des Sirenes1,bohemian, luminous apartment

comments: Carlina and Her place are excellent. There are public transport stations nearby which is great in a city like NYC. Also many groceries stores and affordable food options near. The neighborhood is kind of far from Midtown Manhattan but, as mentioned earlier, subway and bus stops are very near.
listing_name: Great and private place to stay in Manhattan!

comments: Niko was awesome! We arrived later than we had planned, but Niko didn't mind -- he said it happens all the time. The room was perfect for the two of us and looked just like the pictures. Niko's posting is titled "location is everything" and he was right! We were in town to do some of the touristy things and to see Wicked, which was at a theater a couple blocks away. There were lots of bars and restaurants nearby and Niko recommended some of his favorites for us. The neighborhood was really nice and perfect for wandering around and exploring. The subway was just a couple blocks away which made for easy travel for sightseeing. This was our first experience with airbnb and we were lucky to have had such a great host to start out with!
listing_name: Location is Everything!

comments: Suraj's house is really nice and very clean. We all had a very great weekend there! I will love to come back again next time.
listing_name: 2-story, 3-bedroom, Private Yard

comments: We had a great time staying at this beautiful apartment. It is efficient and with exotic antique decorations well put together. Best of all, Mustafa has made the apartment so welcoming. He stocked up the refrigerator with milk, juice, eggs, fruits, etc. He truly holds the philosophy that treats people as you will like to be treated. He was also very accommodating to let us store our luggages in his store before the check in time since our flight arrived really early. We strolled around the city and our luggages were in the apartment by the time we went back. It was like staying with your old friends.
listing_name: Wanderlust. A perfect private space to unwind.

comments: Todd's apartment is an excellent base for enjoying some time in New York. It's only a few minutes from Manhattan by train and is a quiet and comfortable place to come back to when the day is over. Thanks Todd!
listing_name: New Williamsburg 1B With Backyard

comments:
Mark was very welcoming and was always responsive to every question we had. We didn't had a single problem.
The apartment was clean and just as it look online. All worked fine: the bed were comfortable, the kitchen fully equipped, air conditioner worked on the living room and was much appreciated with the very high temperatures of the week.
The neighborhood was quite, surrounded by restaurants and grocery stores to buy everything you could need. I never felt insecure even returning at 2 am.
The subway was a 10 min walk, and from there was a 30 - 45 min ride to Manhattan.
I would definitely recommend Mark and the apartment. We had a very nice week in it.
listing_name: Elegant Stuyvesant Heights Retreat

comments: Amazing location, we felt safe and everything was convinient. Dean and his roomates were very frendly and was readily checking if we needed anything.
listing_name: Sunny Room with Private Bathroom in Great Location

comments: Amazing apartment, convenient to the metro which is about 20 mins to Manhattan. Made use of the epic cinema room to put our feet up after a long days sightseeing.
listing_name: Mid-Century Modern Garden Paradise

comments:
Stacey was a great host! Amazing communication and super easy to deal with. Loved staying at her apartment in LES.
Thanks so much!
listing_name: Spacious Studio + Patio

comments: Ahmet and his wife were perfect hosts, providing everything I needed during my stay and always being friendly and polite. Had a great experience and would recommend. For its location in Queens the transport was convenient.
listing_name: Large, Sunny Room near Manhattan

comments: The location is awfully good. It's only takes me 5 minutes to the subway station ( 137th Street Station). And you can take Train 1 to most places such as Time Square, Bus Terminal (To airports and other places operated by Greyhound) , Penn Station( Amtark) and South Ferry etc. Most importantly, Hugo and his familes are really nice. Thank you so much Hugo, CU next time.
listing_name: The Hideaway

comments:
Superbeliggenhed i hjertet af new york og Susan sørgede for at lejligheden var ren og klar til os
meget sikker bygning med dørmænd som sikrer at der ikke kommer fremmede ind i bygningen
Moderne vaskeri, så vi havde taget for meget tøj med
Vi kommer helt sikkert tilbage
Kærlig hilsen

Tine&Aldo
listing_name: Located at the heart of Manhattan

comments: Juan is a host par excellence.  And I wont have second thoughts book this apartment when I get the chance to visit New York. In fact, I have been telling my friends that should they go to New York and in need of a place to stay they should ask me for I know of a good one. Not in Manhattan but very accessible, safe, clean and peaceful. Juan attended to our needs and made sure that what we needed is available. There were six of us who stayed in the apartment and he made sure that everyone had a place to sleep in. The property is as advertised spacious, comfortable and quiet - a good place to rest after a day of exploring Manhattan. The bed is so comfortable that it's a struggle to get up in the morning and start exploring. The apartment is a 10 to 12 minute walk from the train station and just a street or two away from the bus  station where you get a ride to downtown Brooklyn while having a peak at  some parts of the district. As advertised there are at least two good places to eat near the apartment like Peaches and Saraghina - if you are starting late these restaurants are very good to load up for the day's exploration. Juan was very accessible and he answered every question i asked even before i made the booking and his level of engagement never diminished even on the day that we left. the apartment is well maintained and clean. Juan even helped us with our luggage and that wasn't just a gesture for we had some large pieces of luggage. on the day of our arrival, Juan gave us an orientation of the apartment (it's more than a hundred years old) and the neighborhood, which is safe,  quiet and the kind that grows on you as days go. Juan provided complimentary wine, soda and bottled water, allowing us to rehydrate upon arrival.  We replenished this with our own supply from the store at the corner. The apartment has Wifi and i think the signal comes from the ground floor so that may affect the speed of the Internet but it works to our satisfaction that I didn't even raise it as matter to Juan.  Thank you very much, Juan. I hope you will never grow tired of hosting and may the quality of your apartment remain superb.
listing_name: Alexander's 2BR Quarters

comments: I live in Ridgewood, near this apartment, but my family was coming from Spain so I wanted to put them up in a place near by for convenience of meeting up purposes. The room we rented was in the basement with access to a small terrace in the back. Very nice, clean, and quiet. It's a simple space with the main necessities that you would need if you're looking for a room to just crash in, shower, and relax after exploring the city. The only cons I would say is there was no television (for my 16 & 17 year old siblings), and there was no A/C. The hosts were very available via text with any questions I had, and according to my parents very helpful even with a language barrier. I would highly recommend Julian & Karen's airbnb to anyone traveling to new york. Easy access to the J train which takes you right into the city, and the local bodegas and stores make getting last minute groceries easy.
listing_name: Brooklyn Cove 1 Br Apt w/ Garden In Bushwick!!

comments: I have just returned from my trip to the US. We arrived to Gladys and Ben after a long journey and were warmly received by Gladys. She helped us with the suitcases, showed us and explained to us everything in the house, made us feel comfortable from the first second we met. As they live there they said we can all them anytime if we needed anything. The neighborhood is fine and the connection to Manhattan is excellent. In short, it was our first experience with this site and it was a very good experience.
listing_name: Astoria/LIC  Private Home located near train

comments:
We recommend Gus and Holly ;)
It was really a good trip for us and a beautiful meet .
The bedroom was comfortable .
Gus was in host to high quality, really nice and helpful and considering.
Holly was really nice with us .
And we can't never forget the cats so cool and nice too :)
Thank you for this journey we hope to read you soon. ;)
See you next year for a new traveling .:D
listing_name: Cozy “Indie Rock”Room in the Heart of Williamsburg

comments: Laura was friendly and kind enough to let me arrive earlier than stipulated. The room is basic, but it's at a great price! I would stay here again
listing_name: LaGuardia Room(2) with Private Entrance

comments: Lisa and Nancy were wonderful! Their place was cozy and very clean. The back deck area was very peaceful and I would highly recommend their place for all visitors. Thank you for a great stay!
listing_name: “Home Away from Home”: Large room Near Train & Bus

comments:
It was first to time to use airbnb but staying with Gus & Holly was great experience.
The room was exactly as pictured, cozy and nice. Everything I need was there.
Gus and Holly were very nice, friendly and helpful. Cats were also adorable!

It was easy to access to subway station in only few minutes and 10 minutes to Manhattan. The flat was maybe not quite centre in Williamsburg but it's walk distance, no problem. There are some nice restaurants / bagel shop just around corner.
When I visit NY next time, I want to stay with them again.
listing_name: Work From Our Home w/ Loft

comments: I enjoyed my stay with Vie.  She was great.  Very pleasant.  The property was very quiet and clean.  It gave you a private feel.  I will stay her again.
listing_name: FIFA Ready Room* in shared pad* metro* safe

comments: Our family spent 4 days at Lighthouse Manor. The place was everything as promised and had everything we needed (and even more). The hosts were responsive to all our needs. The place itself is located about 7-8 min. from the bus stop that takes to the ferry to get to Manhattan. Although it takes around 1,5-2 hours to get to Manhattan by public transport there is no problem to come back later at night since the neighborhood is really peaceful and safe (we even enjoyed late night walks from the bus stop back to the place).
listing_name: The Lighthouse Manor

comments: 房子很整洁、比较新，内部设施完善，周边超市买食材和物品也方便。地理位置方便，但离中央公园其实还隔离一个街区，当然走路还是很近的。中央公园最美的位置应该是在靠近60-70街的地方，而这个房子的位置已接近100街了。
listing_name: Luxury 1 Bedroom Central Park Views

comments: The manager Tony was really easy to coordinate with by email in advance; he and my sister exchanged all the keys/information needed.  We highly recommend the place and are so glad we rented it!  It is a really wonderful location for Brooklyn or Manhattan access; the street stays fairly quiet and we had no trouble parking.  Appliances and modern decor are all good.  Stairs in front and inside were an issue for some in our family, but we loved the multiple patios, the spacious kitchen/dining/living level, the excellent bathrooms.  Three of the beds and all linens are high quality.  It really accommodates 1 couple and two people, not so much three couples, and the extra "bedrooms" are an air mattress beside the piano and a very small fold-out single in a study.
listing_name: *Available 1 year* 5BR Multi-Terrace Sunny Apt!

comments: Marie was great. Great value and I would stay here again for sure!
listing_name: Lovely, Furnished room connected with a bath!

comments: We spent at Russel’s apartment 3 nights and it was really great. The studio is located in a beautiful area nearby the subway.  This cozy apartment gives You everything You need to feel like a born newyorkerthe interior design and many  books  around give You the feeling like You would be spending weekend at  Your best friend’s house which makes Your trip comfortable and unforgettable  We highly recommend his studio and NYC! Hope to get back there soon
listing_name: Uptown Studio With Character

comments: Sophie was a great host! I would especially recommend this place to women traveling alone, as this place is very safe. Bathroom and living areas were very clean! The location is deep in Brooklyn but there are shops near by and a train that is a few minutes away. Sophie was warm and friendly and welcome in my home whenever she is in LA. Great place!
listing_name: Brooklyn Zen Gem Restful Retreat

comments: This apartment was perfect, it was like brand new . It was a very clean apartment.  Ziporah  was there to greet me when I arrived I didn't get there until late evening, that was much appreciated. I can't say enough about how special the apartment is. It was very quiet, the kitchen is beautiful the whole place is beautiful, everything you need to cook is in the kitchen. But if you don't want to cook there are good restaurants right there in her neighborhood .I've stayed in Apartments in different parts of the world this is the best one I've stayed in. This one's going to be hard to beat! Central Park is a block away which I really enjoyed! Ziporah  really cares about me and she was very easy to get in contact with. I will be telling all my friends that visit New York about the apartment. The apartment is exactly how it looks in her pictures on the website on air bnb.thanks again Ziporah  Jan
listing_name: Beautiful Apartment Near Central Park

comments: Laura was a great host, very friendly, and welcoming. Her home is in the perfect location if you need to be close to the airport, a quick 5 minute drive, it's close to restaurants and a mini market where we were able to walk to get dinner. The room we stayed in is in a basement and it felt a little strange to stay in a bedroom with no window at first, but we quickly got over it. The space was however in need of some cleaning, the shower was moldy and did not have hot water (we showered with lukewarm/cold water), and there was dog waste outside. We were not able to sleep too well either as we are both light sleepers and continuously heard what seemed to be scratching noises upstairs, what we assumed was by the dogs in the home. Overall we thought this was a decent choice considering we would have paid more at all hotels near the airport and since it was just one night.
listing_name: LaGuardia Room (1) with Private Entrance

comments: It was awesome in NYC and what it made it even better was Wing and her brother Mac. They are really fabulous and helpful people. Their place looks exactly like how it appears in the pictures. They were respectful, clear and totally accommodating. I did want to thank them for being such wonderful hosts. The place definitely is a little far from the city but is a great option if someone's visiting to be near the Howard beach/ JFK airport area. All the things were operational at home. It was peaceful and neighbours were non-pokey. All-in-all a great experience was fuelled by Wing's great place.
listing_name: Sunny, serene airport NYC getaway

comments: Location was good, nice and safe although there are not a lot of restaurants and places for eating something in the area. We stay only one night for going to the airport the day after. Jessica was kind, she aswered very quickly and asked us if all was ok. But the problem is the house itself... first because it is not nice (it's a basement with a very low roof and noisy plumbing) and above all because it was dirty! We didn't share the house with other people so it means that they didn't clean or did it badly. I couldn't stay there anymore.
listing_name: Basement 别墅的地下室

comments:
I found Alicia's apartment very convenient and comfortable with a surprisingly delightful view out the bedroom window. Alicia herself was accommodating and personable without being intrusive.

This will be a go-to option for me on my travels to the City.
listing_name: Bright Room With A Great River View

comments: Dans une rue calme de Brooklyn, nous avons été très bien accueillis par Eric et Justin. Nous avons trouvé un appartement spacieux, propre avec tout ce qu'il faut pour être reposé et bien installé des notre arrivé après de longues heures de vol. Le top, le frigo avec quelques denrées alimentaires et le petit de bienvenue sur l'ardoise ! Vraiment le top ! À 10 minutes du métro, NETFLIX de disponible avec quelques films en français bref si à l'avenir nous voyageons de nouveau vers NYC, c'est ici que nous retournerons.
listing_name: Large private suite in our home in Brooklyn.

comments: Staying at Julia and Shawn's place was great! Very accommodating and clean with everything ready when we got there...including a bottle of wine! Best stay in ny using airbnb yet!
listing_name: Cosy Apt:  Brooklyn, near B/Q, 2/5 subway & buses

comments:
Christine helped me with the bags on arrival and gave me the apartment to myself the whole time which was cool. she always answered quickly if i had any question. i liked the apartment since it is in the heart of new york and near the subway and cheap. However, there are a few things that i didnt like:
- the windows dont close so staying there in the winter may be a problem, especially since it was cold when i was there and there was no adequate heating
-there was alot of dirt and dust inside and everywhere and under the couch. I tried to clean, but the smell of dust was bothersome i had a difficult time falling asleep.
the apartment is okay but had the owner invested more in it, it would have been a nicer experience for the guest
listing_name: Cozy, Clean, Convenient Location

comments:
We just had a fantastic New York weekend staying in Tanushree's apartment. She was so friendly and warm, and really great about being in touch. Her list of recommendations for restaurants, activities, and shows was so long we couldn't even get to them all, but every one we did was AMAZING!

We chose her place because of the location, the cute interior, and particularly the private bathroom, and all of those things were great. You can't get a private bathroom at a hotel in NY for this price, and it also comes with a lot of hospitality as well!
listing_name: BEAUTIFUL&BRIGHT 1 bd (E. Village)

comments:
Ehren is a welcoming, accommodating host. We were on reverse schedules so most of our encounters were in passing. Super laid back and considerate. He adapted to our schedule which was perfect because we arrived early and left late.

The neighborhood is close to the train and about a 20 minute ride into the city. Plenty of bars and restaurants nearby too. His carefully curated apartment is fantastic. Honestly couldn't have asked for a better space to stay and would definitely do it again.
listing_name: Bohemian Paradise in Industrial BK

comments: Brian was a wonderful host.  This was my first stay at an Airbnb, and it went really smoothly.  His place was exactly as described.  You are in one small bedroom,  he is in the other.  And we barely saw each other. Yet he makes it clear that you are welcome and his home is your home.  The washer/dryer was a big plus, and the location is fantastic.  Plenty of eating and drinking options in his neighborhood.  I was joining family members who were staying in midtown,  so I pretty much just slept here.  Brian is a big traveller himself, so he knows how he would like to be treated as a guest.
listing_name: Hell's Kitchen, Midtown west!

comments: Norga's mother showed us around this spacious main floor apartment.  She was very kind.  The apartment is very nice on a beautiful street.  Lots of breakfast selections.
listing_name: beautiful brownstone

comments: The apartment was clean, comfortable, spacious, close to the subway and hassle free. This place was a great find. No complaints.
listing_name: Garden floor in Brooklyn home, 20 min to Manhattan

comments:
The location of this appartment is quite good; 7min from the subway Lorimer st and then 10 min to Union Sq. Bedford avenue where all the cool cafés and bars are, is 15min walk.
The appartment is in a nice house (there is a second appartment below but we didn't see anyone). The bathroom and kitchen/living room upstairs are new and modern. The 2 bedrooms are quite big but haven't been renovated yet. The aircon in one of the room let some wind come in. We were lucky that it was not too cold outside. The beds are really confortable and the linens provided very warm, so it was all good.
Ryan is a great host. We didn't meet him but he was available by email and sent us a very detailed info sheet prior our arrival.
It is a good value appartment for New york and could definitely stay there again next time.
listing_name: Sunny 2 bdrm W'burg Duplex w/ 3 beds. 5* superhost

comments: Our hosts were extremely gracious and their home is beautiful. The location, overlooking the East River and the Manhattan skyline, was a treat.
listing_name: Bedroom and bathroom in the heart of Williamsburg

comments:
Estuvimos un amigo y yo durante una semana en la casa de Gilberto y todo estuvo bien. La ubicación está bien, a 20 minutos en autobús de Central Park y 20 también del midtown de Manhattan en subway. Cerca hay un supermercado Associated y un McDonalds.
La casa está bien, la cocina cuenta con todo lo necesario. Gilberto es muy respetuoso y nos Dios mucha autónomia y privacidad.
listing_name: A large comfortable room for rest and relaxation

comments: Wonderful place. Lots of room. Very clean. The location was perfect for exploring Brooklyn and a quick walk to the train. We will definitely stay here again.
listing_name: Park Slope Studio

comments: We had a very accommodating and easy experience at Claude's. All the other reviews say it all. Great location, excellent and kind host with very renter friendly environment. All the basics are there that you might need and Claude is a very hands-off host, allowing you to come and go as needed.
listing_name: Near Times Square and Hell's Kitchen

comments: Mei-Yann's place was awesome! Would definitely recommend it to anyone.
listing_name: Artsy Studio. Top of Central Park. Cozy, Clean

comments: Our stay was fantastic here! There was a group of 7 of us from California for a week, and we all fit pretty snugly in the "dorm style" set up with the way the beds were arranged in both rooms! We had plenty at our fingertips too, towels, ironer for our shirts, and close access to the YMCA gym and markets. The A train is convienent but a far walk when coming back late at night, so try and always use the "G" train! Go outside, turn right, right on Bedford and walk up a few blocks. Thanks again, fantastic hosts!!!
listing_name: Truly A Sweet Home away from Home.

comments:
Two of us stayed for 13 nights early December. Great place and great location. 10 minutes walk to Madison Square Park and Flatiron, Union Square etc.

Eatery galore up 3rd and Lexington avenue. You'll not want for anything food wise. Also helps that there is a well stocked supermarket just around the corner. We got our basics there ie bread, milk, some toiletries etc.

Quiet area as far as New York goes - quiet neighbours too.

Nice strong shower and comfortable bed. The apartment is well heated which is important for this time of the year.

Paul who was our contact was very responsive and helpful. Greatly appreciated his assistance whenever we needed it.

All in all this made for a very pleasant New York stay for us.
listing_name: Flatiron studio + dining / sunlight

comments: We had great time staying here! I would definitely recommend staying with them and I will probably end up staying with them again when I go back to NY. They're both very welcoming and make you feel right at home.
listing_name: Beautiful Large Sunny Bedroom

comments: We very much enjoyed our stay with Ted and Jenny in New York City. They did so much to make us feel welcome and comfortable and provided everything that we could possibly need during our stay. The mini-tour of the local area and closest subway stops on our first morning was an extra bonus that helped us get around with a lot less confusion! Thank you for making our stay so great.
listing_name: Bedroom in my apartment with a private bathroom.

comments:
New York is an amazing city, and the apartment is very well located, as it is very close to the subway.
Omar is very friendly and resolved all the concerns we had.
The check in and check out in difficult schedules Omar solved it wonderfully.
listing_name: Huge Duplex only minutes from NYC

comments: Katja was awesome. We really enjoyed our stay in this very charming 1 bedroom apartment. The apartment is within close proximity to the L-train which provided nice convenient transportation into the City. Clean, affordable, and safe housing at a very reasonable rate. Thanks Katja!
listing_name: Authentic Apartment in the heart of Brooklyn

comments: Devon's apartment was conveniently located in the center of Williamsburg. I did not meet Devon, but her roommate was very nice and helpful in getting checked in (also has a really cute dog!). The room was small, but cozy and clean. Overall enjoyed my one night stay!
listing_name: Private Room 1 Stop From Manhattan

comments: A great host.  All was fantastic.  Very helpful.
listing_name: Artistic Penthouse with Deck + Piano

comments: Dan's and Elise's apartment was just perfect. Located very close to the subway (7 minutes walking) with an express train to Manhattan to bring you there in 30 minutes. Yet, the street of the apartment is completely quiet and decent with beautiful Victorian-style houses. We enjoyed the Christmas decoration at night and were invited to take pictures by the neighbors. Sunset park district in Brroklyn is a nice area with a lovely Latin community, all kind of stores and restaurants around, close to the river and Manhattan and not far from JFK airport. The apartment itself is great, too. Spacios room, comfortable beds, warm and quiet, everything is brandnew and you could find just everything that you need - from olive oil, coffee, fresh juice and oranges in the fridge to towels, body lotion and an information kit with all data about the neuighborhood (restaurants, taxi numbers, the closest hospital etc.) We felt like home immediately! Especially we appreciated Dan for being very helpful at any time. Since we could not meet personally he gave us a call I Germany and responded very quickly to any requests. We would definitely love to come again to Dan's and Elise's place! Highly recommended!
listing_name: Serene in Sunset

comments:
Ali was great, with no problems
Area is really chinatown but very close to little italy and soho
appartment was really cool, much better than even the photos
There are a lot of stairs though so it may not suit an old/infirm person.
Overall a great apartment and a great host
merci beaucoup!!
listing_name: Top floor light filled loft on the Bowery

comments: Byrd is a great man! Apartment was as expected from photos. clean well set out and extremely cosy. Byrd was extremely organised showed us where to travel around the streets and had plenty of snacks ready on our arrival. Highly recommend
listing_name: A Beautiful Brownstone Apartment

comments: It was an awesome stay @ Marisa's apartment. The place is very clean and the bed is very comfortable. We had a little challenges when the airline has damaged our baby stroller when we arrived, and Marisa was really quick and helpful by providing a contact to rent a baby stroller. In addition, the USB port under the table in the living hall was a God sent given that we didn't bring our international adaptor
listing_name: 2 bedroom apartment in charming brick townhouse

comments: Dr. Sally was the perfect hostess!  From the beginning, she made  us feel very welcome, and went out of her way to make our stay enjoyable and stress-free.  We had a great time, and would stay again.
listing_name: Cozy Room

comments:
Shelby wasn't able to give us the keys, so she organized a "pick up station" where we could pick the keys up. That was good, everything worked fine!
Unfortunately, the apartment was not that clean as expected. There were guests before we stayed in the apartment, and the bed wasn't cleaned up and hairs were in the shower...
All in all, Shelby is a helpful person and I guess if she would be there in person to welcome you as a guest, the apartment would be clean.
listing_name: Sunny/artistic, Manhattan 2 bedroom

comments: We loved our stay at Kent and Nik's! It was walking distance to beautiful little restaurants, bars and parks. Also a short (5-10minute)  walk from the subway which was helpful! We would definitely stay again.
listing_name: Sunny room in East Village!

comments: This place is small but warm. And it has traffic convenience. I think it is worthy place to live.
listing_name: East Village

comments:
Woooow,Sophie was amazing welcoming friendly smiling super host
The room was very clean and tidy with warm sensation
I love the privacy and feeling in your own home
The room is super identical to the photos on the site
I realy miss my room & I hope be back soon
Sophie & Kottaro was so helpful
listing_name: Brooklyn Zen Gem w/Personal Balcony

comments:
I highly recommend Angela's studio, it is exactly as shown in the pictures and the perfect place for my week stay in NYC with my girlfriend.
Angela gave us very clear directions and made the process easy and simple for us.
As for the neighbourhood, we were close to a wide range of restaurants, 24 hour shops and basically anything we needed.
Transport by metro was just a few blocks away and went all the way down Manhattan.
Overall, a very nice studio and great value for its price.
listing_name: Upper East Side Studio

comments: At first I was hesistant because there's no picture of the place but it was a great surprise. The place is really nice and big and Petrona and her husband are really kind and welcoming. I recommend it without hesitation. It's easy to find and not so far from the subway witch is direct to central New York.
listing_name: Clean Quiet 1 bedroom apartment

comments: Kim's Apartment ist liebevoll eingerichtet und ist in einem angenehmen Wohnhaus gelegen. Die Wohnung war sauber, alles was man benötigt, ist vorhanden. Obwohl ich Kim nicht persönlich kennen gelernt habe, lief alles reibungslos. Das Apartment liegt optimal LES downtown. Die Metro F-Train ist zu Fuß in 3 Minuten erreichbar. Die Linie 6 Bleeker Street ist in Ca. 15 Minuten, Union Square Ca. 25 Minuten erreichbar. NoHo ist nahe gelegen und mit hübschen Cafés und tollen Geschäften ein modernes und junges Viertel. Ich habe mich sehr wohl in Kim's Wohnung gefühlt.
listing_name: Private Space in Lower East Side

comments:
Damien's apartment was exactly as it appeared in the photos. It is a modern apartment in a secure building. Great wifi and shower, and I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great little place in Williamsburg Brooklyn.

Getting into the apartment was a breeze, thanks to Damien providing access after hours with no troubles.
listing_name: Awesomely Sunny 1 Bedroom w Balcony

comments: Rachid made us very welcome. His communication prior to our stay was excellent and the arrangement to meet and receive the keys and further instructions was punctual. The apartment is lovely and was exactly as described and the pictures were accurate. The apartment is spacious and comfortable; there is plenty of light and even a small balcony to sit on if the weather is nice. The kitchen is well equipped.  The location is very good - close to the J train for simple access to Manhattan.
listing_name: Bohemian & Chic Apartment.

comments: A lovely and clean place. I was amidst a week and there were few visitors.
listing_name: Classic Elegance in Brownstone Near Subway

comments: Even better than listed! Gary's place is in the best location of west village. It is directly on top of a delicious coffee shop that permeates the studio in the morning. A delightful wine store is directly across the street and a fresh/green grocery store within a block. It is in perfect location for restaurants and fantastic bars. The studio is clean, comforting, and a great amount of space. The road nose is definitely quite a strong New York "charm" of the place. But we used ear plugs and slept incredibly well in the very comfortable bed. We were snowed in briefly and were disappointed to learn the oven didn't work as restaurants were closing. But Gary was also quick to respond to every need we had in a kind manner. He was also flexible and understanding with our needs related to the snow storm. I HIGHLY recommend this comfortable fantastically located studio. Like I said- It was even better than listed.
listing_name: West Village Loft, 1st floor

comments:
Arthur nos hizo sentir como en nuestra propia casa!
Desde que contacté con él para informarme del apartamento, todo fueron facilidades.
El apartamento tiene 2 habitaciones y está muy bien situado, a sólo 3 minutos andando de la estación de metro más cercana. La cocina y el baño están también muy bien. Las camas confortables y la casa tiene calefacción central y además radiadores eléctricos en cada habitación.
Nos cancelaron los vuelos de vuelta y tuvimos que quedarnos 3 días más, y no tuvimos ningún problema, Arthur fue rápido en la respuesta.

Os lo recomiendo sin dudarlo!
listing_name: Entire 2br apartment in the heart of Chelsea

comments: Room was as advertised and comfortable . The house was clean and in relatively good condition. My only complaint would be that the room was not ready when I arrived at 4:00 pm, they said they needed more time to clean it up .
listing_name: 法拉聖,干净

comments: Jennifer and Ken were wonderful hosts!  They reached out before the trip and when I got there to please let them know if I should need anything at all.  They also checked in with me mid-trip which I thought was just great.  Jennifer and Ken also gave me very helpful information about their neighborhood in terms of restaurants, grocery stores and delis which was terrific as I had not stayed in Harlem before so it helped me navigate the area with ease.  Their apartment was exactly as it was described in the listing - it was a truly beautiful and charming space.  The apartment had everything I needed for a great vacation - a kitchen to store groceries and to cook/prepare/eat any food; a comfortable bed to sleep and couch to also sleep or watch TV (including HULU and Netflix); great Wi-fi service to plan out my days in the city; and wonderful books about Harlem, New York, and my favorite Yankee - Derek Jeter, that I read in the evenings when winding down from a busy day.  Jennifer and Ken are also close to the subways and bus lines to get around which was very convenient for getting around.  I have visited New York many times before this trip but I loved the feeling this visit had of really being a part of the neighborhood.  I hope to stay with Jennifer and Ken again on a future trip to New York.  I had a great time.
listing_name: Stylish & Inviting Brownstone Apt, Close to Subway

comments: I enjoyed my stay, clean comfortable safe location just as listed
listing_name: PRIVATE, CLEAN, ROOM CLOSE TO MANH and LA GUARDIA

comments:
La estadía en el apartamento de Roula fue simplemente maravillosa. Al nosotros llegar fue muy amable con nosotros y nos recibió como si fuésemos familia, con una refrigeradora llena y con chocolates. Ella estaba siempre disponible cuando la necesitábamos.

La limpieza del apartamento fue lo más destacado ya que de rincón a rincón era impecable!! Ningún otro apartamento que hayamos contratado por Airbnb ha tenido tal limpieza y orden.

Las habitaciones, los baños, la cocina y la sala eran completos con todos los implementos necesarios y más!! Era muy espacioso y con una enorme TV HD en la sala para disfrutar en las noches.

El barrio era tranquilo y lo mejor era que tenía muchas posibilidades para parqueo.

Definitivamente eligiría a Roula y su apartamento para una futura estadía... GRACIAS POR TODO ROULA!!!
listing_name: Bright & Charming 1 Bedroom Minutes to Manhattan

comments: Charisse was a wonderful host. Work found me out and around a great deal of the time so if I had one complaint-it would be that I didn't spend as much time in her apartment or in her company as I hoped.... She was welcoming and courteous-a fantastic couple of days in NYC.
listing_name: Skylight BR in Gorgeous Private Rooftop Apt

comments:
Roula Was really a great host. The fridge was full of many usefull products. She gave us all things we asked to her.
The appartment is spacious, very bright, and clean.
I would definitely recommend this place.
Martine
listing_name: Bright & Charming 1 Bedroom Minutes to Manhattan

comments: Staying with Elle was an absolute pleasure! She was so open and welcoming and always up for a chat. We spent time together outside of the apartment and I really do feel like I've made a friend! There's something extremely special about the apartment and I couldn't recommend it more!
listing_name: Loved by NYLocals Private Room SoHo

comments:
Location was perfect! My wallet was stolen in Times Square and hosts went out of their way to assist me!
Apartment was adorable and better than we pictured. Three girls in the city...and we enjoyed every moment of downtime at local coffee spots and eateries. Seriously, would stay again, absolutely in love with Harlem and this listing!
listing_name: Perfect Harlem, New York Retreat

comments: Ethan was a great host. He was very responsive to text messages and gave us plenty of information. The apartment was well appointed, clean, quiet, and looked just like the photos. The neighborhood was also just as described. This location was the perfect home base for our trip - we walked almost everywhere! We would definitely rent this space again. Thanks Ethan!!
listing_name: Modern Manhattan Oasis

comments: Bryan's flat was perfect for us, beautiful and well located. Even though we didn't meet Bryan he has been really good with communication. We recommend this flat for a stay in New York.

comments:
Hemos pasado una semana fantástica en NY, especialmente gracias a la ubicación y comodidades del alojamiento ofrecido por Marco.
Situado en Hell's Kitchen, a escasos 15 minutos a pie de Times Square y cerca de Central Park, tiene numerosos puntos de interés muy próximos; también es muy buena opción de cara a encontrar lugares muy recomendables para desayuno y cena a módico precio.
La estación de metro más próxima (líneas A, C y E, la azul) está a unos 10 minutos a pie, y la ubicación es ideal pensando en el descanso (barrio tranquilo, escaso tránsito de vehículos).
La habitación tiene todo lo que se le puede pedir: cama cómoda para dos personas, ducha, baño, microondas, frigorífico, secador... ¡Y cualquier cosa que puedas necesitar! Porque Marco y su familia siempre están dispuestos a ayudarte con lo que necesites, de forma discreta y muy amable.
Si a todo ello le añadimos el precio por la estancia, la valoración es inmejorable.
¡Thank you so much, Marco and family, for your attention! It has been a great experience that we would live again and again.

comments:
Hans und Sandra waren leider in Deutschland, als wir dort waren, aber sie wurden mehr als würdig durch Silvia- ehemalige Airbnblerin und dann Freundin der beiden- vertreten.
Wir haben uns von der ersten Sekunde an wohl gefühlt. Die Zimmer sind super süß eingerichtet und alles strahlt vor Gastfreundlichkeit. Sogar Bagel, frisches Obst und Getränke haben auf uns gewartet.
Der Weg mit dem Bus zur Fähre dauert ungefähr 15 Minuten. Eine sehr genaue App sagt einem direkt wann der Bus kommt und bis zur Station sind es nur 3 Minuten. Die South Ferry Fahrt jede halbe Stunde und wir haben jede Fahrt wirklich sehr genossen.
Nach eventreichen Tagen kamen wir zurück ins Haus und konnten ganz gemütlich mit Silvia und mit einer heißen Tasse Tee über den Tag reden und uns gute Tipps einholen. Die Zwei Katzen waren super lieb. Wir haben sie gerne in unser Zimmer gelassen, man kann aber die Tür immer zu machen, wenn man Katzen nicht mag.
Absolute Empfehlung, mehr zu Hause in New York geht wohl nicht!

comments:
This is one of the better apartments we rented in the NYC area. It is in a quite area of Bayside, Queens but minutes away from highway and about 20 minutes away from Flushing (a huge plus if you like Asian food).

The apartment we rented is on the second floor of a 2-story, 2-family attached house. Our apartment occupies the entire second floor. Once inside, what impresses the most is the level of renovation and owner’s attention to details. Most of the furniture is IKEA, kitchen is stocked with a large variety of tea, coffee and condiments, kitchen wares are aplenty, and toiletry products including toilet paper and paper towel will rival those of the high-end resort hotels.

The owner takes away the living room to make maximum sleeping capacity, leaving four bedrooms. This is just fine as the kitchen in the center of the apartment features a large dinner table underneath a fan-lighting fixture.

Two very minor complaints: (1) The flat screen TV in the kitchen has Direct TV but with only basic service, which precludes even the local news channels. (2) two out of the four bedrooms are without a/c units, which would have been nice during the hottest days (that we unfortunately encountered). Opening the windows would have been fine except for the noisy garbage trucks in the early morning.

In summary, we had a very pleasant experience during our stay and we would give a 9.5 out of 10. If I were an apartment owner, this is exactly how I would prepare my place for Airbnb.

comments:
We just had a very nice two-week stay in this apartment.
The apartment is spacious, clean, comfortable and cool and has a good air-co for the warm days and is located in a quiet, tree-lined street.
Michael is just a perfect host. The process of checking in and out was smooth (we could leave our bags after check out). Every now and then Michael was checking whether everything was fine and he is happy to hear about our day-to-day experiences and he is adding to it with many local tips.
The location is just as we hoped for. It's a very nice neighbourhood in Brooklyn with many shops and restaurants and 'local life' all around for many blocks. Also the metro provide easy and convenient access to all where you want to go in Manhattan and Brooklyn and even Queens.
Tip for an activity in the neighbourhood: get breakfast from one of the bagel shops, the take bus B63 to Brooklyn Bridge Park Pier 6. Stroll north to Brooklyn Bridge and have breakfast any where on one of the piers along the way with the best views on Manhattan. After that, of course walk across the bridge to City Hall Park. Another 'local' tip: don't forget to visit Prospect Park on a Sunday enjoy the foods at Smorgasburg and the music at Drummer's grove.

We highly recommend this place and we would definitely stay here again would we visit New York again sometime.

comments:
J.D. and Stephanie's place was a wonderful place to stay while visiting New York City. My husband and I wanted to experience the city like a local, and they offered great suggestions on where to eat, what to do, and how to navigate around via subway and ferry.
We loved the location so much that we ended up staying in Brooklyn during most of our trip — they’re in a great neighborhood that’s only a 5 minute walk from Bedford Ave where you could spend all day eating amazing food, listening to music, and discovering incredible cocktails. Make sure you get beer and waffles at Sweet Chick!
And just a few blocks from their apartment is an incredible brunch place called Marlow & Sons that J.D. and Stephanie recommended. We went there nearly every day for brunch! Pies N’ Thighs is also nearby, and certainly don’t miss out on Arhchie’s pizza. From their place, we could get everywhere we wanted to go within a 5 minute walk or 10 minute Uber ride.
They also suggested we visit the Record store "Rough Trade" and we ended up spending most of the afternoon there. The record store had a coffee bar, live music, and the largest selection of vinyl we've ever seen. Full disclosure: we snagged some limited edition Star Wars vinyl. Rough Trade definitely didn’t disappoint.
J.D. and Stephanie’s apartment also had access to a little rooftop that would be perfect for a picnic in the summer. We went put here a couple times for a beautiful view of the city scape — great for pictures too. We loved their little family and fell in love with Rowland the cat. Seriously, he’s pretty much a dog. Absolutely stay here if you’re looking to experience the city from a local’s perspective. That’s how Griffin and I prefer to travel, and this was the perfect place. Minutes from the subway, short walks from amazing food, and just a 15 minute ride away to Manhattan.
Thanks for making our adventure so spectacular!

comments:
Abi’s apartment is just fantastic: quite spacious, very cool, and exceptionally well equipped. The bed is very comfortable, the kitchen contained everything you need and more (from essentials to nice teas and coffee). The bathroom is one of the apartment’s highlights, with technology applied to comfort in a style that I had only previously seen in Tokyo. I won’t say more not to spoil the surprise.

The location of the apartment is very good, in a part of Brooklyn that is undergoing a huge transformation and half a block away from Morgan’s metro line. You’ll see some trucks and factories but also organic markets, cool bars with gardens, restaurants and vintage shops. Of course you won’t hear birds singing when you wake up and there are occasionally some sounds but you’re in NYC, right?

As a host, Avi has been perfect. In fact, far beyond what is expected. There were chocolates, beers and milk waiting for us in the apartment. Everything was extremely tidy and clean and he made every possible effort to make us feel welcome. Couldn’t have asked for more.

In sum, if you’re looking for a wonderful place to stay in NYC, stop looking and book Avi’s apartment!

comments:
Firstly, Antonio is a superb host. Through no fault of his own the gas was shut off on our first day meaning that we could not shower when we arrived (the fault was due to one of the neighbours). Antonio messaged ahead of time to let me know and made sure to gas was sorted as soon as possible the next day. And although we had not been very inconvenienced by this he refunded some of our money after we left, completely unprompted!
The apartment itself was clean and well kept. We were each impressed at how quiet the neighbourhood was and were not disturbed at all. One thing to consider is that noise travels within the apartment so if anyone is watching TV while you are in bed next door you will hear it word for word. Or perhaps my father is just losing his hearing...
Connections to Downtown and Midtown Manhattan are easy and quick via two subways. However I don't believe Antonio's assertion that you can be in the city within 20 minutes is correct. Maybe if you were very lucky and all subway connections lined up perfectly, but really it's going to be more like 45 minutes. But this is still a great time to be in and out of Manhattan for the price you are paying so do not let that dissuade you!

I would say that the wifi was not very helpful. My laptop connected to it fine but it was not strong enough for any of the phones and tablets we brought. I guess this is as much a reflection of how small devices are not so good with these connections, but be aware that if you are planning on using iphones/ipads to plan trips out you may struggle.
Lastly I would say that any negatives I have written here are completely outweighed by the huge positives of having a helpful and communicative host and a cosy and quiet apartment. I have included the small negatives just so other people can have as much information as possible, but would heartily recommend this apartment to anyone. I know that when I next come back to Brooklyn I will be firstly checking if this place is available.

comments: I have mixed reviews about this apartment. Pros: It's close to Fulton St. where there was everything we needed, groceries, laundromat, dry cleaner, great restaurants and a really nice park for our two year old son. Cons: I'll start with the worst: Me, my husband and my little boy were bitten daily by mysterious bugs that itched for at least a week each time we were bitten, and we had about 8 bites each. I blew it off at first thinking it was just mosquito bites, but the bites were too small. I noticed the host had an ant problem, but it wasn't overwhelming, at least inside the house. I didn't think there were enough ants coming in from the garden, but considered it a possibility. My husband mentioned that he saw a flea, and I eventually saw a few fleas too. I brought this up to the host so he could do something about it for the next guest, he said that they were not fleas, they were ants. I do know the difference between a flea and an ant, and he has both. Then he told me they were not ants or fleas, they were tiny spiders that come in from the garden. I didn't see these spiders, but maybe they are just that tiny. Either way it sounded like it had been a problem in the past, something he was aware of and I'm not sure if he has gone the extra mile to get rid of them. He said he sent someone to spray outside, but we were bitten inside, we rarely used the outside area because there were an insane number of ants. Which brings me to the outside area, it's really beautiful, but full of ants. The furniture is all useless and broken. And the first week, I found a ton of glass from broken beer bottles. For the price of this apartment, which is double the mortgage for our five bedroom house in LA, we expected there to at least be a spatula we could use for cooking. While the apartment does have cookware, dining ware etc. We had to buy cooking utensils and a broom and other small things most AirBNBs have. And by the way, we are now staying in an AirBNB less than a mile away that has everything we need and costs about $2k less a month. Lastly, his neighbor, who is the nicest man in the world, who has lived there for 35 years, throws a party nearly every night on his front stoop that can last until 2 or 3 am. On our first morning there I was woken up at 6am. If you are staying in the room near the garden or in the living room, you won't hear it, but if you stay in the room facing the street, it is like you are sitting right on the stoop with everyone else. I wore ear plugs and was able to sleep some of the time,...

comments: It was such a delight to stay in this remarkable apartment. Tip for those staying in the summer: if you are a light sleeper, bring ear plugs to help with the noise from the air conditioning in the bedroom - we are not used to it, being from Scotland. The area is very industrial, with nearby neighborhoods being culturally-diverse places where real people live rather than 'tourist' areas. We enjoyed spending time in the nearby 'Industry City' design center with cool cafes and shops. Mostly we took Ubers to get to other parts of Brooklyn as we did not have much time and that seemed easier than figuring out the public transportation, but added some cost onto our spend for the weekend. We loved meeting Doug and Tommy. The home itself was very neat and cozy, the owners provided me with very clear instructions on how to check in, and they were very responsive. All the basic amenities were included, and there were even more unexpected available options, which you should explore by yourself ;-) I really loved the neighborhood - seemed to be safe, with many shops and bars, some of which were open 24/7. I felt so relieved every time after the whole day of sightseeing when I came back to Sara and Greg's place to regenerate before having another day full of attractions offered by the city. Sara and Greg also expressed their own opinions regarding the places, which are major touristic attractions. I highly recommend their place if you want to experience New York City and are travelling either alone like me, or with family/friends. Thank you, Sara and Greg! Beautifully restored Victorian home about an hour commute from lower Manhattan, including about a 12 min. walk to the Astoria-Ditmars W/N line train station.

But if your value the cost-savings over time/convenience, are flying out of LGA, aren’t here for a long-term stay (as there aren’t dressers for clothing storage or cable as one long-term guest mentioned to me,) don’t mind a little noise from other guests whom you can here due to it being an older home without carpet or sound dampening insulation, I would choose this place as it was decorated and remodeled so beautifully!

She said no one rented the apartment the day prior to my arrival, so I would be able to check in early in the morning. The day before my trip, I messaged her again asking where to meet her for the keys. She responded, but failed to tell me that someone had eventually booked for the night before my arrival. Upon arrival on the day of, I messaged to let her know I was on my way and she finally told me someone was in the apartment and I would have to wait for them to get out and for her to clean. No problem. I dropped off my bags, went for breakfast, and came back. When I got into the apartment, I noticed there was only ONE roll of toilet paper. The shampoo and conditioner bottles were almost empty, with just enough for one use. The hand paper towel was completely done and not replaced. The air condition was extremely loud, and as a light sleeper I had a hard time falling asleep. The couch in her apartment was broken on one side, when I sat down i nearly fell to the ground. The second morning of my stay, there was no hot water. It was on a Saturday, and her response was that it was out of her hands to fix due to it being a weekend. No alternative, no accommodation. I told her I would need to get reimbursed and leave to a hotel as this was an inconvenience. After finding out what my complaints were, Mayra decided she had some of her own. She messaged me, accusing me in an unprofessional manner of smoking in her apartment. I did not. I wouldn't even have the time to considering I wasted two hours of my day looking for a decent priced hotel to move to when she should have offered her assistance, that would have been the least she can do. Terrible experience.

Only downside was it is directly across the street from a bar so it does get noisy at night and home was very hot so only way to try to cool down common area was to open windows as air conditioning is in the bedrooms.

comments:
We had a wonderful stay at Miriam's. The apartment is just as represented on the listing. Miriam has put together very detailed instructions which help a great deal. The location is excellent with lots of restaurants and shopping nearby and a short distance (a couple of blocks) to the train (F and G).
If you are driving into the city, this is the shortest commute I found after staying over a month in Brooklyn to Manhattan. You will take the Hugh L Carey tunnel (toll by mail) to get in and the traffic in the mornings is not that bad. However, I'm not sure how you take the toll without an EZ Pass so you might want to research that if you don't have one. There's free street parking but you will have to play musical cars depending on street sweeping days but this is everywhere in Brooklyn.
Miriam has lots of plants which we helped take care of. I have to be honest, if it were just me, it would probably be too much responsibility with my work schedule. But if you have someone that stays home during the day or has a more flexible schedule, it would be more manageable.
The master bedroom was super comfortable with a huge comfy bed and a great shower. Her kitchen is fully stocked which makes cooking easy. Air conditioning worked well on some of the hottest days of the summer. Miriam was an excellent hostess and made it very easy to communicate or resolve any issues that might come up. The neighbors are nice and friendly. The neighborhood is clean and safe. I had a great stay that felt like home and would absolutely recommend it to anyone visiting New York.

comments:
If you’re looking at Izaac & Cash’s place to stay while doing anything in Brooklyn/NYC, go ahead and book the dates you’re looking at ASAP because I can only imagine this place being booked at all times once people know about it!
The space itself is a wonderful retreat to come to after a day around Brooklyn or in the city, located off a beautiful shaded street with historic brownstones all around. You have your own private entrance leading to your own private bathroom and room - complete with your own private balcony from the room with an amazing panoramic view of Brooklyn and Manhattan. The room itself has floor to ceiling windows, an adjustable A/C unit/heater to cool you off during the hot summer days, a bed more comfortable than my own with soft fresh linens, and plenty of storage space with drawers if you’re the type to “move-in” to the space during your stay. The restroom is a beautiful standup as seen in the photos they have, and comes with any little extras you may have forgotten such as extra towels, shampoo, lotion, etc.
The best part of the stay was that we were hosted by two of the kindest people in Izaac and Cash. They are both readily available by message if we needed anything, they are easy to talk to in person whenever they were home, and they take good care of their home and guest room. If you’re looking for a comfortable, stylish, clean home to stay in and hosts that are welcoming and available, stop looking and book this one now.
P.S. I ended up forgetting two shirts in the room and Izaac was kind enough to notify me on the way to the airport, and he has gone out of his way to send it via mail to me. It just goes to show that you can find plenty of Airbnb’s with a plethora of listed amenities, but finding kind hosts that will go out of their way is something rare. You will definitely find this in Izaac and Cash!

Because of this alone, I don't know that I'd stay here again. We also found that it was closer to the length of six blocks to get to the train station considering the length of some of the blocks and that the apartment and trains are at the far ends. When I arrived there were two large towels and both still had some stains on them, the hallway and the apartment always had a musty smell and would alternative between smelling like trash/human waste and heavy cleaning products. The toilette would only flush every third flush or so and there was a pile of dust and webbing in a closet. I also kept waking up itchy and with bites I couldn't explain. The wifi was also so bad that the TV was as useful as a painting and I couldn't ever video call home. I reached a breaking point when I came home from work one day to a dead cockroach on the floor of the apartment. I communicated with Ignacio and he told me that the cockroach is just a result of standard cleaning procedures and that the toilette worked, and he didn't find bed bugs. My knowledge of cockroaches is that if you see one, there are at minimum dozens you don't see, as the musty smell and my bad allergies also indicated. I tried working with Ignacio and Airbnb for a refund as I only stayed half the time and had to find other housing because it was so unclean. Unfortunately, I was not refunded and Airbnb was not very responsive so I ended up paying just under $2,000 for about a 2-week stay - which is an unfortunate waste of money. I would not recommend it.

Me alojé durante ocho días en una de las habitaciones de la casa de Tj. Es una casa grande que cuenta con unas 9 habitaciones para Airbnb. Hay dos plantas, cada una tiene su cocina y baño. Quiero destacar (ya que yo no lo leí) que no se puede usar el horno y los fuegos, por lo que si planeas cocinar durante tu estancia, no lo recomiendo demasiado, aunque está disponible el microondas, nevera, tetera etc.
Se comparte la casa con bastante gente, a veces es incómodo que el baño está ocupado y hay que estar esperando. La cocina suele estar bastante vacía. La casa cuenta con camaras en espacios comunes.
La habitación era espaciosa y estaba limpia, aunque una de las toallas tenía unas manchas. La cama es grande y muy cómoda, aunque suena bastante cuando te tumbas/mueves. La habitación no tiene armario grande pero si algunos espacios para guardar ropa en las mesillas de noche. El tren pasa cerca de la casa y se oye, en mi caso no fue molesto, pero si hay personas muy sensibles con el ruido no les recomendaria elegir esta habitación, ya que el metro funciona durante toda la noche.
La habitación cuenta con un código para entrar, lo que me resultó muy cómodo, al igual que la entrada principal de la casa. Además, el check out es a las 10 am pero me permitieron dejar la maleta hasta las 11-12 pm. Meela siempre respondió muy rapido a todos los mensajes.
La casa está muy bien situada ya que a 5 minutos andando llegas al metro (36 av) por lo que en apenas 20-30 minutos estaba frente a Central Park.

comments:
I had a mostly good stay at Sigfus‘s place.
The good:
It is 1 block from the Montrose Avenue L train subway stop in Brooklyn. You can’t beat that for convenience.
It is very clean, with modern art and lots of plants. A desk in the room, books, very comfortable bed, a lock on your door. Very large bedroom. I’m a single woman, and I felt very safe in the apartment and walking around the neighborhood.
The kitchen is VERY well stocked with a small refrigerator, dishes,hot plate, pots and pans, toaster oven, microwave, coffee, tea, Nespresso, and some condiments. Kitchen table, kitchen bench with cushions and a wooden desk chair that can tip back like a rocker. There’s a nice bathroom. There is no living room.
If you have lower back pain, you may not be 100% comfortable sitting in the kitchen. But that may not be an issue for you. AND there’s a chair in your room you could use.
Sigfus lives in the apartment next-door, so when I needed help operating the Nespresso, he immediately came over. he is very nice. His and his wife’s office is at the corner of where I stayed, but I never heard them in there.
Not as good:
The kitchen has a small AC and a small air filter. This kept that room nicely cool. However, the bedroom has a radiator that you cannot turn off. As a result, I was too hot in that room. Even when it was 32° outside. I was there in March.
I could have opened the large window, but there was no screen and there’s a busy street on that side of the room, so the loud car radios, honking, and voices would have woken me up.
Had there been another guest staying in the bedroom next to mine, I would have left my bedroom door open to get the AC. But there was a guest so I did not do that.
Sigfus did promptly provide a small fan at my request.
There is one bedroom next to the other bedroom, so you may or may not have a fellow apartment mate while you stay there.

comments: Bring your own cleaning crew if you want to stay here. It’s not well kept at all. There is trim coming off the wall, mold, dings and dents, cobwebs and overall not clean. You’re given one moldy towel for your entire stay no hand towels or rags. Also, there is only a very thin tissue paper blanket and no top sheet. I’m not sure if the sheets were clean considering the “cleaner” came but there were dirty socks on the floor and a hanger in the shower when we arrived. The “shower curtain” was also made out of tissue paper I think. Overall, it’s $100 a night but if you can avoid this place you should.

comments: This is a room without a tv that is an excellent crash pad to explore the city. Assad is flexible and accommodating. Probably the best feature is that the 2 subway train is less than a block from your door and takes you to lower Manhattan. The M60 bus is very easy to navigate to LaGuardia. It’s also very close to several excellent Harlem restaurants: Amy Ruth’s, Harlem Shake, Red Rooster, and more. Bed was comfortable, window AC was pumping, black out curtains are clutch, and the shower has good water pressure. Small kitchen available if you want to cook. Shared bathroom for the stay and my co-habitant was a male who Asaad told me about beforehand. Door lock on the room is comforting. This is an old building, make sure your expectations are in line with that type of experience because Asaad does a great job. Central Park is only a few blocks.

First, I really appreciated that Seth accommodated my request for an early check in for my 1 night stay. He was flexible with my check in time and I messaged him quite often the few hours before I arrived and he was really understanding. When I arrived around 11 AM, things were a bit messy, but totally understandable because it was prior to my actual check in time. However, I came back around 1 PM(after official check-in), and he was still in my room working on his laptop. Along the same lines, Seth sent a message at night asking when I’d be back since his friend was working on renovations for his kitchen. Which otherwise would be fine, except he sent it around 12 AM. It was a little odd that his friend was working so late into the night, and I didn’t want to voice my discomfort in front of him. The space was small, and the kitchen is in between the room and bathroom, so it was awkward for my friend and me to maneuver around, especially at night when we just wanted to shower and get ready for bed. The friend didn’t pack up the kitchen until 1 AM.
The room itself was clean and tidy, and the bed was extremely comfortable. The location really is excellent. Seth was accommodating and I overall enjoyed my stay but these instances had me a little disconcerted.
