comments:
We had an incredible four day stay in New York City and this beautiful corner, studio apartment was essential in making our trip so enjoyable. We were two blocks from the Herald Square subway station in midtown which gave us quick and easy access to every area of the city. We were right on Broadway and had a wonderful view of the hustle and bustle. We also had a magical view, right from our bed, of the top portion of the Empire State Building that dazzled us each night with it's breathtaking lights. We had five minute walks to drugstores, restaurants (in various price ranges), street food, coffee houses, and shops.
There was free luggage storage prior to check-in which allowed us to drop our bags and head straight out for adventure. Check-in and check-out were a breeze. They also offer luggage storage after check-out for a very reasonable rate. Their office is located at reception 5 (past the security desk and lobby, down the hall to the right and on the right side) and they are there most of the day to help you with whatever you need, even though we actually had no needs! The room was stocked with towels, plates, cups, a fridge, and a microwave which made it easy to settle in and get comfy. We were able to pack so much into one short trip because we had such an amazing location to come home to every night. It was warm, and safe, and welcoming. We could walk all day and take in all the sights, and we knew we could come home and relax with no worries. And every moring we woke up to the Empire State Building inviting us to enjoy another amazing day in the city.
I can't begin to explain how fortunate I felt to be a part of it, right in the heart of the city, living like a local. I plan to visit more often, and every time I will book with Alberto. Our trip was flawless.

The apartment doesn’t get any daylight—the windows face an inner courtyard, but at least there was no noise from the street in the apartment.
The kitchen had all the utensils needed to cook, which is great if you’re on a budget and want to save on dining out.
Check-in and check-out were smooth and hassle-free, which made our stay even more comfortable.
A couple of nights were quite hot, and we couldn’t figure out how to adjust the heating. Turning on the ACs was VERY loud.
Otherwise, it had all the essentials we needed (although there was no extra blanket, despite our request).

At first the party took place in the living room, then the party moved to the garden, which does not change the fact that it was still very loud. The party lasted until around 2 a.m. which is funny because on the host's airbnb it is written that curfew is from 11 p.m. In the morning I quickly left the place.

comments:
I stayed at Alfred’s place for a short trip while attending a convention. The hostel is in a very convenient location that was only a short walk to everything I needed. It’s also within a couple minutes from the metro and Amtrak stations, and with public transportation you can also easily get to the airport.
The unit was small, but I had all the essentials I needed and felt secure. This was my first stay at a hostel and I’ve always been worried about security, but each unit, each floor, and the building all have a lock.
Alfred and his team took great care to address noise concerns. They disclosed that the hostel may not be the best place for snorers but they provide sound proofing blankets, nasal strips, and earplugs. Someone snored during my first night and a team member addressed it quickly.
The common spaces are cleaned regularly and the showers can be locked. There were some breakfast foods.
If you’re in need of a place with the basics, I would recommend staying here!

comments:
3*=ok, not great: location-5*, communication-5*, cleanliness-1*, comfort-3*, value for $-1* average of all the above=3*.
We pick Ike’s place based on its location and it is great-really in the heart of what makes New York fun. We walked everywhere and the F train is just across the street. Ike had good recommendations and they were spot on.

comments:
Die Wohnung ist sauber und war für uns als Familie von 5 Personen für ein Wochenende in New York vollkommen ok.
Die Küche kann man nutzen, über die Kaffeemaschine haben wir uns gefreut und die Kommunikation mit Christoph bzw. seinem Property Manager Alesh war sehr nett und angenehm.
Eine etwas liebevollere Ausstattung der Wohnung und der Küche mit etwas Glas und Porzellan wäre wünschenswert.
Da wir mit dem Mietwagen unterwegs waren, haben wir uns über kostenlose öffentliche Parkplätze auf der Straße in Nähe der Wohnung gefreut.
Dies bedeutet aber auch, dass die Wohnung eher außerhalb liegt, in einem Viertel mit relativ viel Industrie und Werkstätten im Hinterhof, mit Wohnungen gemischt. Sicher eine eher einfache Wohngegend, keine Restaurants oder ähnliches in der Nähe und mit einer Bahn in 50 m Entfernung.
Die Entfernung zur nächsten Metro sind 5-7 Minuten zu Fuß, dann sind es ca. 25 min nach Williamsburg im Zentrum von Brooklyn und auch nach Südmanhattan.
Aber so ist New York!
